definition: A conveyance: a spacious device for carrying or transporting substances, objects, people or animals.

example.es: Tom deambulaba adelante y atrás.

definition: The process of achieving agreement through discussion.

example.en: Far from being a failure, our negotiation was a great success.
example.es: Lejos de ser un fracaso, nuestra negociación tuvo un gran éxito.

definition: a system of parts

example.en: We don't have a mechanism for sustained funding.
example.es: No tenemos un mecanismo para sustentar la financiación.

definition: an outer garment

alternatives.definition: A covering of material, such as paint.
The fur or feathers covering an animal's skin.

example.en: I like this coat. May I try it on?
example.es: Me gusta este abrigo. ¿Puedo probármelo?

definition: Rule by the people, especially as a form of government; either directly or through elected representatives (representative democracy).

example.en: In a democracy, all citizens have equal rights.
example.es: En una democracia, todos los ciudadanos tienen los mismos derechos.

definition: a small pouch in clothing

alternatives.definition: Of a size suitable for putting into a pocket.

(sports, billiards, pool, snooker) An indention and cavity with a net sack or similar structure (into which the balls are to be struck) at each corner and one centered on each side of a pool or snooker table.

example.en: He often walks with his hand in his pocket.
example.es: Suele caminar con la mano en el bolsillo.

definition: having good luck

alternatives.definition: Producing, or resulting in, good fortune

example.en: Tom was lucky enough to find a good job.
example.es: Tom fue lo suficientemente afortunado para encontrar un buen empleo.

definition: a violent collision

alternatives.definition: (computing) A malfunction of computer software or hardware which causes it to shut down or become partially or totally inoperable.
(finance) A sudden large decline of business or the prices of stocks (especially one that causes additional failures).

example.en: The sole survivor of the crash was a baby.
example.es: El único sobreviviente del choque fue una bebé.

definition: The act of observing, and the fact of being observed (see observance)

alternatives.definition: A judgement based on observing.

example.en: Will you permit me to make an observation?
example.es: ¿Me permitís hacer una observación?

definition: animal flesh used as food

example.en: He threw a piece of meat to a dog.
example.es: Él le arrojó un pedazo de carne a un perro.

definition: The act, process or ability of concentrating; the process of becoming concentrated, or the state of being concentrated.

example.en: All it takes is concentration and solitude.
example.es: Todo lo que requiere es concentración y soledad.

definition: An implying, or that which is implied, but not expressed; an inference, or something which may fairly be understood, though not expressed in words.

alternatives.definition: Logical consequence.

example.en: The implication was that where there was a well, there were residents.
example.es: La implicación era que donde había un pozo, había residentes.

definition: be worthy of

example.en: What did I do to deserve this?
example.es: ¿Qué hice para merecer esto?

definition: Not usual, out of the ordinary.

example.en: He told his stories in a very unusual way.
example.es: Contó sus historias de forma muy inusual.

definition: protect from harm

example.en: We have to defend our country at any cost.
example.es: Tenemos que defender nuestro país a toda costa.

definition: of the highest quality

example.en: What's your favorite classic rock song?
example.es: ¿Cuál es tu canción de rock clásico favorita?

definition: a male monarch

alternatives.definition: A checker (a piece of checkers/draughts) that reached the farthest row forward, thus becoming crowned (either by turning it upside-down, or by stacking another checker on it) and gaining more freedom of movement.
To promote a piece of draughts/checkers that has traversed the board to the opposite side, that piece subsequently being permitted to move backwards as well as forwards.

example.en: Once upon a time, there lived a cruel king.
example.es: Había una vez un cruel rey.

definition: mutual action

example.en: Social interaction is the very foundation of social life.
example.es: La interacción social es el fundamento mismo de la vida social.

definition: restore to good condition

alternatives.definition: The act of repairing something.

example.en: It cost me 5,000 yen to repair my bicycle.
example.es: Me costó 5.000 yenes reparar mi bicicleta.

definition: The act of collapsing.

alternatives.definition: To cease to function due to a sudden breakdown; to fail suddenly and completely.

example.en: I'm about to collapse.
example.es: Estoy al borde del colapso.

definition: To receive (something) from somebody temporarily, expecting to return it.

alternatives.definition: (arithmetic) In a subtraction, to deduct (one) from a digit of the minuend and add ten to the following digit, in order that the subtraction of a larger digit in the subtrahend from the digit in the minuend to which ten is added gives a positive result.

example.en: He can borrow my moped for a few days.
example.es: Él puede tomar prestado mi ciclomotor durante unos cuantos días.

definition: Related to a foundation, base, or basis; serving as a foundation.

example.en: This is a fundamental question.
example.es: Esta es una pregunta fundamental.

definition: a shallow container

alternatives.definition: (in the plural) Tableware (including cutlery, etc, as well as crockery) that is to be or is being washed after being used to prepare, serve and eat a meal.
(telecommunication) A type of antenna with a similar shape to a plate or bowl.

example.en: She breaks a dish every time she washes dishes.
example.es: Ella rompe un plato cada vez que los lava.

definition: in or to a foreign country

alternatives.definition: Beyond the bounds of a country; in foreign countries.
alternatives.meaning: a extranjis; al extranjero; en el exterior

alternatives.definition: (dated) At large; widely; broadly; over a wide space.
alternatives.meaning: en todas direcciones; por todas partes

example.en: He has a plan to go abroad next year.
example.es: Tiene un plan para ir al extranjero el próximo año.

definition: (religion, folklore) The spirit or essence of a person usually thought to consist of one's thoughts and personality, often believed to live on after the person's death.

example.en: A man's body dies, but his soul is immortal.
example.es: El cuerpo del hombre es mortal, pero su alma es inmortal.

definition: able to do something

example.en: She is capable of teaching both English and French.
example.es: Ella es capaz de enseñar tanto inglés como francés.

definition: win against

alternatives.definition: To overcome in battle or contest.
To reduce, to nothing, the strength of.

example.en: You can't defeat Tom alone.
example.es: No puedes derrotar tú solo a Tom.

definition: Pertaining to a president or presidency.

example.en: The Socialist Party groomed him as a presidential candidate.
example.es: El Partido Socialista le preparó como candidato presidencial.

definition: With perfection.

example.en: Don't shout like that. I can hear you perfectly.
example.es: No grites así, te escucho perfectamente.

definition: improve

alternatives.definition: To augment or make something greater.

example.en: Can we enhance the image?
example.es: ¿Podemos aumentar la imagen?

definition: feeling deep satisfaction

example.en: I know how proud you are of your work.
example.es: Sé lo orgulloso que estás de tu trabajo.

definition: a serious unexpected situation

example.en: I want to sit next to the emergency exit.
example.es: Quiero sentarme junto a la salida de emergencia.

definition: Of, or relating to education.

example.en: Educational reforms still have a long way to go.
example.es: Las reformas educacionales aún tienen un largo camino por delante.

definition: To recognize someone or something as different from others based on its characteristics.

example.en: It is not easy to distinguish good from evil.
example.es: No es fácil distinguir entre el bien y el mal.

definition: Having a substance; actually existing.

alternatives.definition: Having good substance; strong; stout; solid; firm.
Large in size, quantity, or value; ample; significant.

example.en: The difference is substantial.
example.es: La diferencia es sustancial.

definition: not far away

example.en: He pulled the wounded soldier to the nearby bush.
example.es: Él arrastró al soldado herido hasta un arbusto cercano.

definition: A person or company that manufactures.

example.en: The manufacturer guaranteed the new machine for 5 years.
example.es: El fabricante garantizó la nueva maquina por 5 años.

definition: An item of play equipment that children can climb up and then slide down again.

alternatives.definition: The falling of large amounts of rubble, earth and stones down the slope of a hill or mountain; avalanche.
An inclined plane on which heavy bodies slide by the force of gravity, especially one constructed on a mountainside for conveying logs by sliding them down.

example.en: In our park, we have a nice slide for children to play on.
example.es: En nuestro parque, tenemos un magnífico tobogán para que los niños jueguen.

definition: Having a great value.

example.en: She is wearing a valuable ring.
example.es: Ella lleva puesto un valioso anillo.

definition: In a personal manner.

example.en: Personally, I don't think we should be doing this.
example.es: Personalmente, pienso que no deberíamos estar haciendo esto.

definition: the front of the chest

alternatives.definition: The figurative seat of the emotions, feelings etc.; one’s heart or innermost thoughts.
The ventral portion of an animal’s thorax.

example.en: Mary was diagnosed with breast cancer in October.
example.es: A Mary le diagnosticaron un cáncer de pecho en octubre.

definition: (liturgy) A long, loose cloak worn by a priest, deacon, or bishop when presiding over a ceremony other than the Mass.

alternatives.definition: To deal effectively with something, especially if difficult.

example.en: You have to cope with those difficult problems.
example.es: Tienes que afrontar esos difíciles problemas.

definition: Imprecise but close to in quantity or amount.
meaning: aproximadamente; a eso de; más o menos

example.en: It's better to be approximately right than completely wrong.
example.es: Es mejor estar aproximadamente en lo cierto que estar completamente equivocado.

definition: (chiefly, British, usually, a mass noun) Lodging in a dwelling or similar living quarters afforded to travellers in hotels or on cruise ships, or prisoners, etc.

alternatives.definition: The adjustment of the eye to a change of the distance from an observed object.
The act of fitting or adapting, or the state of being fitted or adapted; adaptation; adjustment.

example.en: Dormitory-style accommodation is available in the lighthouse.
example.es: Hay alojamiento disponible a la manera de un dormitorio en el faro.

definition: emphasize

alternatives.definition: (figurative) An especially significant or interesting detail or event or period of time.
To mark (important passages of text), e.g. with a fluorescent marker pen or in a wordprocessor, as a means of memory retention or for later reference.

example.en: The bioluminescent bay was the highlight of our trip.
example.es: La bahía bioluminiscente fue lo mejor de nuestro viaje.

definition: A journalist who investigates, edits and reports news stories for newspapers, radio and television.

example.en: The reporter refused to name his sources.
example.es: El reportero se negó a revelar sus fuentes.

definition: the weather conditions of an area

example.en: The climate here is milder than that of Tokyo.
example.es: El clima aquí es más suave que el de Tokio.

definition: (clothing) An article of clothing that is worn on the upper part of the body, and often has sleeves, either long or short, that cover the arms.

example.en: This shirt is too small for me to wear.
example.es: Esta camisa es demasiado pequeña para ponérmela.

definition: The act of excepting or excluding; exclusion; restriction by taking out something which would otherwise be included, as in a class, statement, rule.

alternatives.definition: An objection; cavil; dissent; disapprobation; offense; cause of offense.

example.en: This is an exception to the rule.
example.es: Esta es una excepción a la regla.

definition: A body corporate, created by law or under authority of law, having a continuous existence independent of the existences of its members, and powers and liabilities distinct from those of its members.

example.en: Some board members questioned his ability to run the corporation.
example.es: Algunos miembros de la junta cuestionaron su habilidad para dirigir la corporación.

definition: a small piece

alternatives.definition: A damaged area of a surface where a small piece has been broken off.
(games, gambling) A token used in place of cash.

example.en: Why don't we all chip in thirty dollars?
example.es: ¿Por qué no aportamos todos nosotros treinta dólares?

definition: One who has won or often wins.

example.en: It is good to be a winner.
example.es: Es bueno ser un ganador.

definition: meet unexpectedly

alternatives.definition: A meeting, especially one that is unplanned or unexpected.

example.en: That was our first encounter.
example.es: Ese fue nuestro primer encuentro.

definition: of a color like earth

alternatives.definition: An Irish surname of Anglo-Norman origin, a translation of de Brún.
To become brown.

example.en: The piano was made of beautiful, dark brown wood.
example.es: El piano está hecho de preciosa madera marrón oscuro.

definition: take air into lungs

example.en: In high altitudes, people find it hard to breathe.
example.es: En grandes altitudes la gente encuentra difícil respirar.

definition: a reason given

alternatives.definition: To forgive; to pardon; to overlook.
To relieve of an imputation by apology or defense; to make apology for as not seriously evil; to ask pardon or indulgence for.

example.en: They just want an excuse to fire you.
example.es: Solo quieren una excusa para despedirte.

definition: in part

alternatives.definition: In part, or to some degree, but not completely.

example.en: I can't help but feel partly responsible.
example.es: No puedo ayudar pero me siento parcialmente responsable.

definition: (sports) A sport played by two players (or four in doubles), who alternately strike the ball over a net using racquets.

example.en: I went to the park to play tennis.
example.es: Fui al parque a jugar al tenis.

definition: Relating to towns and cities rather than the countryside.

alternatives.definition: (uncommon) A en given name.

example.en: The urban population of America is increasing.
example.es: La población urbana en América está creciendo.

definition: make unclear

alternatives.definition: To mix thoroughly; to confound; to disorder.

example.en: We shouldn't confuse solitude with isolation. They are two separate things.
example.es: No se debe confundir soledad con aislamiento. Son dos cosas separadas.

definition: Of or pertaining to a southern region, especially Southern Europe or the southern United States.

example.en: Naples is the largest city in southern Italy.
example.es: Nápoles es la ciudad más grande del sur de Italia.

definition: the amount produced

alternatives.definition: (economics) Production; quantity produced, created, or completed.
(computing) Data sent out of the computer, as to output device such as a monitor or printer, or data sent from one program on the computer to another.

example.en: The output of this factory has increased by 20%.
example.es: La producción de esta fábrica ha aumentado un 20%.

definition: The quality of being (especially visually) attractive, pleasing, fine or good-looking; comeliness.

example.en: I'm a lover of beauty in all its forms.
example.es: Soy un amante de la belleza en todas sus formas.

definition: large and heavy

example.en: A massive flood paralyzed the local transportation network.
example.es: Una masiva inundación paralizó la red de transporte local.

definition: set up for use

example.en: The man tried to install his own antenna.
example.es: El hombre trató de instalar su propia antena.

definition: determine by mathematics

example.en: It's not hard to calculate.
example.es: No es difícil de calcular.

definition: a small rodent

example.en: When was the last time you killed a mouse?
example.es: ¿Cuándo fue la última vez que mataste a un ratón?

definition: the science of number

example.en: She was good at mathematics in high school.
example.es: Ella era buena para las matemáticas en la enseñanza media.

definition: At a higher level, rank or position.

alternatives.definition: (shoemaking) The piece of leather, etc., that forms the top part of a shoe above the sole.

example.en: Only the upper echelon has access to the best trainers.
example.es: Sólo el escalón superior tiene acceso a los mejores formadores.

definition: the act of creating

example.en: The Genesis creation narrative does not mention fungi.
example.es: El relato de la creación en el Génesis no menciona a los hongos.

definition: take up space or time

example.en: Two bodies cannot occupy the same place in space.
example.es: Dos cuerpos no pueden ocupar el mismo lugar en el espacio.

definition: A line marking the boundary of an object figure.

alternatives.definition: A general description of some subject.
A statement summarizing the important points of a text.

example.en: Outline Boston on this map with a red pencil.
example.es: Marque Boston en este mapa con un lápiz rojo.

definition: Possessing adequate talents or accomplishments; of competent power or ability; qualified; fit.

example.en: He has a sufficient income to support his family.
example.es: Él tiene suficiente ingreso para mantener a su familia.

definition: An additional piece of information, an addition to existing information.

alternatives.definition: To bring (a person) up to date: to inform (a person) about recent developments.

example.en: There is an urgent need for them to update their system.
example.es: Se requiere urgentemente que ellos actualicen sus sistemas.

definition: success by chance

example.en: Sooner or later, he will run out of luck.
example.es: Tarde o temprano la suerte lo abandonará.

definition: maintain in original state

alternatives.definition: A sweet spread made of any of a variety of fruits.
An activity with restricted access.

example.en: Doctors and nurses must preserve life at all costs.
example.es: Médicos y enfermeras deberían preservar la vida a toda costa.

definition: Divided.

alternatives.definition: (algebra, of a short exact sequence) Having the middle object (group, module, etc.) equal to the direct sum of the others.
A crack or longitudinal fissure.

example.en: Tom heard that Mary and John had split up.
example.es: Tom oyó que Mary y John habían terminado.

definition: A line, cord, or other thing suspended and hanging loose, upon which anything may swing.

alternatives.definition: (boxing) A type of hook with the arm more extended.
To rotate about an off-centre fixed point.

example.en: The party was in full swing when he left.
example.es: La fiesta estaba en pleno apogeo cuando él se marchó.

definition: a disease

example.en: Mary kept on working in spite of her illness.
example.es: María continuó trabajando a pesar de su enfermedad.

definition: a person who writes for newspapers

alternatives.definition: (originally) The keeper of a personal journal, who writes in it regularly.

example.en: His career as a journalist was full of distinguished achievements.
example.es: Su carrera como periodista estaba lleno de logros distinguidos.

definition: Occurring quickly with little or no warning or expectation; instantly.

example.en: There was a sudden change in the weather.
example.es: Hubo un cambio repentino en el tiempo.

definition: (marketing) A commercial solicitation designed to sell some commodity, service or similar.

example.en: Her clothes are the best advertisement for her dressmaker.
example.es: Su ropa es la mejor publicidad para su modista.

definition: Of a regularly occurring, dependable nature.

alternatives.definition: (logic) Of a set of statements: such that no contradiction logically follows from them.

example.en: What he said yesterday is not consistent with what he said last week.
example.es: Lo que él dijo ayer no es consistente con lo que dijo la semana pasada.

definition: (not comparable) As it was in the beginning; at first.

example.en: Originally they were farmers.
example.es: Ellos originalmente eran granjeros.

definition: to one side

alternatives.definition: An incidental remark to a person next to one made discreetly but not in private, audible only to that person. (theatre) A brief comment by a character addressing the audience, unheard by other characters.

example.en: I think it's time for me to step aside.
example.es: Creo que es hora de que me haga a un lado.

definition: a state of ease

alternatives.definition: A consolation; something relieving suffering or worry.

example.en: Anyone whose comfort level depends on what someone else is wearing really needs to take a long, hard look at themselves.
example.es: Cualquier persona cuyo nivel de comodidad dependa de lo que los demás estén vistiendo realmente necesita echarse una larga y escrutadora mirada a sí mismo.

definition: In the second place.

example.en: Secondly, we must take steps to correct these errors.
example.es: Segundamente, debemos tomar medidas para corregir estos errores.

definition: intense or serious

alternatives.definition: Sober, plain in appearance, austere.

example.en: In my family, the punishment for lying was severe.
example.es: En mi familia, el castigo por mentir era severo.

definition: a unit of heredity

example.en: Some diseases are caused by a defective gene.
example.es: Algunas enfermedades son provocadas por un gen defectuoso.

definition: the possibility of success

alternatives.definition: A picturesque or panoramic view; a landscape; hence, a sketch of a landscape.
The act of looking forward; foresight; anticipation.

example.en: The prospects for Japan's future look dismal.
example.es: Las perspectivas de futuro de Japón son funestas.

definition: The partly frozen, crystalline state of water that falls from the atmosphere as precipitation in flakes; also, the falling of such flakes; and the accumulation of them on the ground or on objects as a white layer.

alternatives.definition: Preceded by the dummy subject it: to have snow (noun sense 1) fall from the atmosphere.

example.en: It has to get cold for it to snow.
example.es: Para que nieve, tiene que hacer frío.

definition: the main events of a story

alternatives.definition: (narratology) The course of a story, comprising a series of incidents which are gradually unfolded, sometimes by unexpected means.
An area or land used for building on or planting on.

example.en: The plot was so complicated that I couldn't follow it.
example.es: La trama era tan complicada que no la pude seguir.

definition: the part of the body connecting head to body

alternatives.definition: To hang by the neck; strangle; kill, eliminate.

example.en: This is a bit too tight around my neck.
example.es: Esto está un poco muy apretado alrededor de mi cuello.

definition: Standards used to judge or decide something; plural of criterion.

example.en: Beauty cannot be determined objectively but depends on personal aesthetic criteria.
example.es: La belleza no se puede medir objetivamente, sino que depende de criterios estéticos personales.

definition: (focus) Of a primary or central nature, first and foremost.

example.en: If your company primarily does business with America, then you should be studying English with a native speaker from America.
example.es: Si tu compañía primordialmente hace negocios con Estados Unidos, entonces debes de estudiar inglés con un hablante nativo de Estados Unidos.

definition: To form into one whole; to make entire; to complete; to renew; to restore; to perfect.

example.en: They have to integrate into society.
example.es: Tienen que integrarse en la sociedad.

definition: The act of criticising; a critical judgment passed or expressed

example.en: People ask you for criticism, but they only want praise.
example.es: La gente te pide crítica pero solo quiere halagos.

definition: A meeting or gathering.

alternatives.definition: A formal agreement, contract, rule, or pact.

example.en: The Geneva Convention is not recognized at Guantanamo.
example.es: La Convención de Ginebra no está reconocida en Guantanamo.

definition: A wager, an agreement between two parties that a stake will be paid by the loser to the winner (the winner being the one who correctly forecast the outcome of an event).

alternatives.definition: To stake or pledge upon the outcome of an event; to wager.
To be sure of something; to be able to count on something.

example.en: Do you want to make a bet?
example.es: ¿Querés hacer una apuesta?

definition: keep possession of

example.en: We had to retain a lawyer.
example.es: Tuvimos que contratar a un abogado.

definition: a particular order

alternatives.definition: (mathematics) An ordered list of objects, typically indexed with natural numbers.

example.en: Genes consist of a specific sequence of DNA.
example.es: Los genes consisten de una secuencia específica de ADN.

definition: clearly visible

alternatives.definition: (computing) Containing no extended or nonprinting characters (especially in plain text).
alternatives.meaning: con solamente caracteres normales; libre de caracteres especiales; sin caracteres especiales

alternatives.definition: Of just one colour; lacking a pattern.

example.en: His meaning is quite plain.
example.es: Lo que él trata de decir es bien sencillo de comprender.

definition: One who enters into, or offers themselves for, any service of their own free will, especially when done without pay.

alternatives.definition: To enlist oneself as a volunteer.
(ambitransitive) To do or offer to do something voluntarily.

example.en: I have a friend who works as a volunteer.
example.es: Tengo un amigo que labura como voluntario.

definition: relating to the countryside

example.en: Have you ever lived in a rural area?
example.es: ¿Alguna vez has vivido en un sector rural?

definition: free from agitation

alternatives.definition: (of a person) Peaceful, quiet, especially free from anger and anxiety.
(of a place or situation) Free of noise and disturbance.

example.en: He looked calm, but actually he was very nervous.
example.es: Parecía estar tranquilo, pero en realidad estaba muy nervioso.

definition: give up completely

alternatives.definition: A yielding to natural impulses or inhibitions; freedom from artificial constraint, with loss of appreciation of consequences. (Now especially in the phrase with abandon.)
To give up or relinquish control of, to surrender or to give oneself over, or to yield to one's emotions.

example.en: The captain gave the order to abandon the ship.
example.es: El capitán dio la orden de abandonar el barco.

definition: The act of examining.

example.en: I studied hard in order to pass the examination.
example.es: Estudié harto para pasar el examen.

definition: A complete lack of sound or noise.

alternatives.definition: (imperative) Be silent.
The act of refraining from speaking.

example.en: Hundreds of soldiers ate in silence around their campfires.
example.es: Cientos de soldados comieron en silencio alrededor de sus fogatas.

definition: With speed; in a rapid manner.

example.en: The river swelled rapidly because of the heavy rain.
example.es: El río subió rápidamente a causa de la lluvia fuerte.

definition: working well

example.en: You should study in an efficient manner.
example.es: Deberías estudiar de manera eficiente.

definition: a fundamental change

alternatives.definition: (astronomy) In the case of celestial bodies, the traversal of one body along an orbit around another body.

example.en: He was one of the leaders of the revolution.
example.es: Fue uno de los caudillos de la revolución.

definition: Joy; pleasure.

alternatives.definition: To give delight to; to affect with great pleasure; to please highly.
alternatives.meaning: complacer; deleitar; hacer las delicias de

example.en: The gifts will delight the children.
example.es: Los regalos les van a encantar a los niños.

definition: A magical effect or influence induced by an incantation or formula.

alternatives.definition: (colloquial) An indefinite period of time ; by extension, a relatively short distance.
(colloquial, US) A period of illness, or sudden interval of bad spirits, disease etc.

example.en: The witch cast a spell on the naughty boy.
example.es: La bruja le lanzó un hechizo al niño travieso.

definition: A proposition antecedently supposed or proved; something previously stated or assumed as the basis of further argument; a condition; a supposition.

example.en: The employee was escorted off the premises.
example.es: El empleado fue escoltado fuera de las instalaciones.

definition: incline

alternatives.definition: (of a person or animal) Slim; not fleshy.
(of meat) Having little fat.

example.en: He has a strong shoulder for you to lean on.
example.es: Él tiene un hombro fuerte para que te apoyes.

definition: Of or relating to the drama.

alternatives.definition: Striking in appearance or effect.

example.en: In music or speaking, a pause is frequently used for dramatic effect.
example.es: En música o hablando, se suele utilizar una pausa para dar efecto dramático.

definition: be unlike

example.en: It's on this point that our opinions differ.
example.es: A partir de aquí nuestras opiniones difieren.

definition: feeling gratitude

example.en: I'd be very grateful if you could help me.
example.es: Estaría muy agradecido si pudieras ayudarme.

definition: a nutrient found in food

example.en: Meat and eggs have a lot of protein.
example.es: La carne y huevos tienen mucha proteína.

definition: short for bicycle

alternatives.definition: Any vehicle sharing some characteristics with a bicycle or motorbike, such as pedal power, a handlebar, or a saddle.

example.en: Do you know how to ride a bike?
example.es: ¿Sabes montar en bici?

definition: To divide into portions and dispense.

example.en: We would like to distribute your product in Japan.
example.es: Nos gustaría distribuir su producto en Japón.

definition: relating to the mind

example.en: Tom is intellectual.
example.es: Tom es intelectual.

definition: To obtain or receive (something) from something else.

example.en: The lonely man derives pleasure from observing ants.
example.es: El hombre solitario se contenta con observar a las hormigas.

definition: of great importance

example.en: The first minutes after a heart attack are crucial.
example.es: Los primeros minutos después de un infarto son cruciales.

definition: The state of having no job; joblessness.

example.en: Since I don't have a job, I get unemployment benefits.
example.es: Como no tengo trabajo, me pagan el desempleo.

definition: A circular device capable of rotating on its axis, facilitating movement or transportation or performing labour in machines.

alternatives.definition: (automotive) A wheelrim.
To roll along on wheels.

example.en: We don't have to try to reinvent the wheel.
example.es: No tenemos que tratar de reinventar la rueda.

definition: a cultivated plant

alternatives.definition: The production amount of such an output for a specific season or year, particularly of plants.
An entire short whip, especially as used in horse-riding.

example.en: Corn is the most highly subsidized crop in America.
example.es: El maíz es el cultivo más subsidiado en Estados unidos.

definition: a smaller group

alternatives.definition: (relational, attributive) Of or relating to a minority.

example.en: You must also respect the opinions of the minority.
example.es: También debes respetar las opiniones de la minoría.

definition: the point of origin

example.en: He is studying the origin of jazz in America.
example.es: Él está estudiando el origen del jazz en Estados Unidos.

definition: An act of interpreting or explaining something unclear; a translation; a version.

example.en: It is subject to interpretation.
example.es: Está sujeto a la interpretación.

definition: Any well-bred, well-mannered, or charming man.

example.en: He is a very gallant gentleman.
example.es: Él es un caballero muy galán.

definition: a play for theater

example.en: Tom joined his school's drama club.
example.es: Tom se unió al club de teatro de su escuela.

definition: the visible features of an area

alternatives.definition: (computing, printing, uncountable) a mode of printing where the horizontal sides are longer than the vertical sides

example.en: He took a picture of the beautiful landscape.
example.es: Tomó una foto del precioso paisaje.

definition: teach

example.en: Parents have an obligation to educate their children.
example.es: Los padres tienen la obligación de educar a sus hijos.

definition: Something to play with, especially as intended for use by a child.

alternatives.definition: To play (with) in an idle or desultory way.
To ponder or consider.

example.en: My dad took my toy out of my hands.
example.es: Mi papá me arrancó el juguete de las manos.

definition: responsibility for a mistake

alternatives.definition: A defect, imperfection, or weakness; more severe than a flaw.
(tennis) An illegal serve.

example.en: I'm ready to admit that it was my fault.
example.es: Estoy dispuesto a admitir que fue mi culpa.

definition: display publicly

alternatives.definition: A public showing; an exhibition.
(legal) An article formally introduced as evidence in a court.

example.en: Tom asked Mary if she'd go to John's art exhibit.
example.es: Tom preguntó a Mary si iría a la exposición de arte de John.

definition: lesser in importance

example.en: He played a minor part in the play.
example.es: Él interpretó un rol menor en la obra.

definition: pursue and kill for food

alternatives.definition: A hunting expedition.
(ambitransitive) To try to find something; search (for).

example.en: I can teach you how to hunt.
example.es: Puedo enseñarte a cazar.

definition: Any disturbed state of the atmosphere causing destructive or unpleasant weather, especially one affecting the earth's surface involving strong winds (leading to high waves at sea) and usually lightning, thunder, and precipitation.

alternatives.definition: (meteorology) A disturbed state of the atmosphere between a severe or strong gale and a hurricane on the modern Beaufort scale, with a wind speed of between 89 and 102 kilometres per hour (55–63 miles per hour; 10 on the scale, known as a "storm" or whole gale), or of between 103 and 117 kilometres per hour (64–72 miles per hour; 11 on the scale, known as a "violent storm").
(military) A violent assault on a fortified position or stronghold.

example.en: The ship was at the mercy of the storm.
example.es: El barco estaba a merced de la tormenta.

definition: Relatively great in extent from one surface to the opposite in its smallest solid dimension.

alternatives.definition: Difficult to understand, or poorly articulated.

example.en: The ice was thick enough for me to walk on.
example.es: El hielo era lo suficientemente grueso para que yo pudiera andar sobre él.

definition: The act of achieving or performing; a successful performance; accomplishment.

alternatives.definition: A great or heroic deed or feat; something accomplished by valor or boldness.

example.en: What do you consider your greatest achievement?
example.es: ¿Cuál consideras que es tu mayor logro?

definition: discuss to reach an agreement

example.en: His job is to negotiate with foreign buyers.
example.es: Su trabajo es negociar con compradores extranjeros.

definition: To govern, rule or control by superior authority or power

example.en: Two bishops working together control so many squares that they can dominate the board.
example.es: Dos alfiles trabajando juntos controlan tantas casillas que pueden dominar el tablero.

definition: One who supplies; a provider.

example.en: I'm thinking about changing my supplier.
example.es: Estoy pensando en cambiar de proveedor.

definition: a thing given as a reward

alternatives.definition: That which is taken from another; something captured; a thing seized by force, stratagem, or superior power.
To consider highly valuable; to esteem.

example.es: Cada uno de los tres niños recibió un premio.

definition: In a typical or common manner.

example.es: ¿Cuánto tiempo suelen durar sus migrañas?

definition: a person of equal status

alternatives.definition: Someone who is approximately the same age (as someone else).

example.es: No te rindas a la presión de los compañeros.

definition: a regular payment to retired people

alternatives.definition: To grant a pension to.

example.en: The old man lives on his pension.
example.es: El anciano vive de su pensión.

definition: (zootomy) An appendage of an animal's (bird, bat, insect) body that enables it to fly.

alternatives.definition: To act or speak extemporaneously; to improvise; to wing it.

example.en: I found a bird whose wing was severely damaged.
example.es: Encontré un ave que tenía el ala gravemente dañada.

definition: The act or process of acquiring.

example.en: The library has many new acquisitions.
example.es: La biblioteca tiene varias adquisiciones nuevas.

definition: A movement of the muscles of the laughing face, particularly of the lips, and of the whole body, with a peculiar expression of the eyes, indicating merriment, satisfaction or derision, and usually attended by a sonorous and interrupted expulsion of air from the lungs.

example.en: Take the time to laugh. Laughter is music for the soul.
example.es: Tómate tiempo para reír. La risa es la música del alma.

definition: To a deep extent or degree; very greatly.

example.en: The story of his brave struggle affected us deeply.
example.es: La historia de su valiente lucha nos conmovió profundamente.

definition: Identifying someone or something already known.

example.en: I don't want admiration, just recognition.
example.es: No quiero admiración, sólo reconocimiento.

definition: a form of energy

example.es: La electricidad volvió luego de unos poco minutos.

definition: Aid; help; the act or result of assisting.

example.en: I need medical assistance.
example.es: Necesito asistencia médica.

definition: the top covering of a building

alternatives.definition: (architecture) The external covering at the top of a building.
The upper part of a cavity.

example.en: I had a new roof put on my house.
example.es: Me pusieron un tejado nuevo en mi casa.

definition: The state of having permanently left one's employment, now especially at reaching pensionable age; the portion of one's life after retiring from one's career.

example.en: Of course, many senior citizens are happy with retirement.
example.es: Por supuesto, muchos ciudadanos de la tercera edad son felices con la jubilación.

definition: In a relative manner; often used when comparing array lists, where the term denotes that the items in the lists correspond to each other in the order they are given.

example.en: Mary and Helen are the godmothers of my two children, respectively.
example.es: María y Helena son las madrinas de mis dos hijos, respectivamente.

definition: The act of varying; a partial change in the form, position, state, or qualities of a thing.

example.en: Obviously there are many variations between these two extremes.
example.es: Desde luego, entre estos dos extremos hay muchas variaciones.

definition: Indicating the last item.

alternatives.definition: Indicating the most important action.
alternatives.meaning: a fin de cuentas; a la larga; al fin y al cabo

example.en: So ultimately, with Tatoeba we are only building the foundations… to make the Web a better place for language learning.
example.es: Así que por último, con Tatoeba estamos estableciendo los cimientos ... para hacer de Internet un lugar mejor para aprender idiomas.

definition: evidence showing truth

alternatives.definition: Suffix added to a noun to form an adjective denoting imperviousness to that noun.

example.en: I have no proof to the contrary.
example.es: No tengo ninguna prueba de lo contrario.

definition: The unconsolidated mineral or organic material on the immediate surface of the earth that serves as a natural medium for the growth of land plants.

alternatives.definition: To make dirty.

example.es: Las lombrices a veces son beneficiosas para el suelo.

definition: Good-looking; well dressed; fine; fashionable.

alternatives.definition: To feel a pungent pain of mind; to feel sharp pain or grief; to be punished severely; to feel the sting of evil.

example.es: No es tan inteligente como su hermano mayor.

definition: a sheet of material

alternatives.definition: A hen kept to lay eggs; a breed of chicken bred to maximize laying output.

example.es: Sin la capa de ozono, estaríamos en peligro.

definition: (of a person, predicative, _, only) Angry, distressed, or unhappy.

alternatives.definition: To make (a person) angry, distressed, or unhappy.
To disturb, disrupt or adversely alter (something).

example.es: Tom se molestó cuando vio a Mary besar a John.

definition: A sharp projection on the blade of a saw or similar implement.

example.es: Nosotros fracasamos por la falta de preparación.

example.es: Una pequeña disputa fronteriza se disparó en un incidente internacional mayor.

definition: a list of items to do

example.en: I apologize for the delay in sending the agenda.
example.es: Pido disculpas por la demora en enviar la agenda.

definition: special importance

definition: The whole number of copies of a work printed and published at one time.

example.es: Que yo sepa, es la edición más reciente.

Having a color like silver: a shiny gray.

example.es: La música es una forma de entretenimiento.

definition: truthful and sincere

example.es: Estoy seguro de que es un hombre honesto.

example.es: Muestra siempre mucha decisión en todo lo que emprende.

definition: Of or relating to the (actual or figurative) sale of goods or services directly to individuals.

example.en: Tourism, retail sales, and finance comprise more than three-quarters of GDP.
example.es: El turismo, las ventas al por menor y las finanzas abarcan más de tres cuartas partes del PIB.

definition: A piece of such material; a thread or slender rod of metal, a cable.

(dated) Happy, joyful, and lively.

example.es: En muchos países, ser gay es motivo de encarcelamiento.

definition: the act of publishing

definition: (sometimes, _, postpositive) Not known; unidentified; not well known.

example.es: Los planes para una nueva zona de libre comercio todavía están en el borrador.

example.es: El agua es un líquido. Cuando se congela, se vuelve sólido.

example.es: El éxito de la empresa sorprendió a todos.

definition: a town with a harbor

alternatives.definition: A type of very sweet fortified wine, mostly dark red, traditionally made in Portugal.

example.en: Could you show me the way to the port?
example.es: ¿Podría indicarme el camino hacia el puerto?

definition: an area for playing a sport

alternatives.definition: A sticky, gummy substance secreted by trees; sap.
A throw; a toss; a cast, as of something from the hand.

example.en: This is a good place to pitch a tent.
example.es: Este es un buen lugar para levantar una carpa.

definition: The act of arriving (reaching a certain place).

definition: a movable barrier

alternatives.definition: (computing) A logical pathway made up of switches which turn on or off. Examples are and, or, nand, etc.

example.es: Él pudo resolver el problema con facilidad.

definition: an alcoholic drink

example.es: Fui a beber una cerveza con los amigos.

example.es: Tom es otorrinolaringológo.

example.en: I try to keep a low profile now.
example.es: Ahora trato de mantener un perfil bajo.

definition: a temporary state of mind

alternatives.definition: A mental or emotional state, composure.

example.es: El niño subió a bordo del avión con buen ánimo.

example.es: ¿Vas a grabar el capítulo de hoy?

definition: a narrow opening

alternatives.definition: A narrow opening.

example.es: Se estaba escapando gas de una grieta en el tubo.

example.es: Tom trató de llamar a Mary numerosas veces.

definition: To yield or give way to another.

example.es: Él decidió presentar su renuncia.

example.es: ¿Es la primera vez que tienes este síntoma?

example.es: Sería virtualmente imposible convencer a Tom de ir con nosotros.

definition: a period of time

example.es: La invención del transistor marcó una nueva era.

definition: An amount by which something or someone is covered.

example.es: En esta zona no hay cobertura.

example.es: Había mucha tensión entre Tom y Mary.

alternatives.definition: (nautical) A strong rope or chain used to moor or anchor a ship.
(TV) Ellipsis of cable television, broadcast over the above network, not by antenna.

example.es: Necesito un cable USB nuevo.

definition: easily affected

example.es: Esta carta tiene información sensible que puede ofender a algunas personas.

definition: easily alarmed

example.es: Tom parece estar más nervioso que yo.

definition: what is put in

example.es: Tom necesita nuestro aporte.

definition: set apart

alternatives.definition: Something that has been isolated.

example.es: En la investigación médica, uno de los problemas más grandes es aislar la causa de la enfermedad.

definition: a person held in captivity

alternatives.definition: A person incarcerated in a prison, while on trial or serving a sentence.

example.es: Tom fue un prisionero de guerra durante tres años.

example.es: Si la humanidad no cuida el medio ambiente, el medio ambiente podría eliminar a la humanidad.

example.es: Esto está un poco muy apretado alrededor de mi cuello.

example.es: Tengo que cambiar una cuerda a la guitarra.

alternatives.definition: To become foggy or gloomy, or obscured from sight.

example.es: Vi una nube blanca flotar a través del cielo.

example.es: A veces es difícil persuadir a los niños a comer.

definition: fill with enthusiasm

example.es: La maestra de arte estaba supuesta a inspirar a los estudiantes a ser creativos.

definition: magnificent

Having higher rank or more dignity, size, or importance than other persons or things of the same name.

example.es: Tom tiene un piano de cola en su salón.

definition: for this reason

example.es: A la luz de lo que nos dijo, creo que deberíamos revisar nuestro plan.

definition: An implicit suggestion that avoids a direct statement.

alternatives.definition: To imply without a direct statement; to provide a clue.
To bring to mind by a slight mention or remote allusion; to suggest in an indirect manner.

example.en: Do I detect a hint of sarcasm in your reply?
example.es: ¿Detecto un poco de sarcasmo en tu respuesta?

definition: A rod bent into a curved shape, typically with one end free and the other end secured to a rope or other attachment.

alternatives.definition: To catch with a hook (hook a fish).

example.en: Hang your hat on the hook.
example.es: Cuelga tu sombrero en el gancho.

definition: a hollow object that rings

alternatives.definition: (music) The flared end of a brass or woodwind instrument.

example.en: I will leave as soon as the bell rings.
example.es: Me iré tan pronto como suene la campana.

definition: a substance that flows

alternatives.definition: (phonetics) Any of a class of consonant sounds that includes l and r.

example.en: Water is liquid. When it freezes, it becomes solid.
example.es: El agua es un líquido. Cuando se congela, se vuelve sólido.

definition: an uncontrollable fear

alternatives.definition: To cause (someone) to feel panic; also, to frighten (someone) into acting hastily.

example.en: I don't want to cause a panic.
example.es: No quiero causar pánico.

definition: The brother or brother-in-law of one’s parent.

example.en: I owe what I am today to my uncle.
example.es: Lo que soy hoy en día se lo debo a mi tío.

definition: a cereal grain

example.en: He ate rice twice a day for many years.
example.es: Él comió arroz dos veces al día por muchos años.

definition: An area of ground that tends evenly upward or downward.

alternatives.definition: The degree to which a surface tends upward or downward.

example.en: We climbed a steep slope.
example.es: Escalamos una empinada cuesta.

definition: The emotion of being happy; joy; elation.

example.en: It goes without saying that you can't buy happiness.
example.es: No hace falta decir que la felicidad no puede comprarse.

definition: truly what something is said to be

example.en: Even the experts took the painting for a genuine Rembrandt.
example.es: Hasta los expertos tomaron la pintura por un Rembrandt genuino.

definition: A person as a container of qualities or feelings.

example.en: A blood vessel burst inside his brain.
example.es: Se reventó un vaso sanguíneo dentro de su cerebro.

definition: (grammar) A word that indicates an action, event, or state of being.

example.en: A sentence normally has a subject and a verb.
example.es: Generalmente un enunciado tiene un sujeto y un verbo.

definition: consider or think

alternatives.definition: To count; to enumerate; to number; also, to compute; to calculate.
To count as in a number, rank, or series; to estimate by rank or quality; to place by estimation; to account; to esteem; to repute.

example.en: I reckon it's time for us to leave.
example.es: Creo que es hora de que nos marchemos.

definition: Laughable or amusing through foolishness or a foolish appearance.

alternatives.definition: Good; pious.
Mentally simple, foolish, particularly:

example.en: He was silly enough to believe her.
example.es: Él fue tan tonto que le creyó.

definition: The act of transporting, or the state of being transported; conveyance, often of people, goods etc.

example.en: A massive flood paralyzed the local transportation network.
example.es: Una masiva inundación paralizó la red de transporte local.

definition: Any place of shelter.

alternatives.definition: To provide a harbor or safe place for.

example.en: The ship couldn't leave the harbor because of the storm.
example.es: El barco no pudo dejar el puerto debido a la tormenta.

definition: a humorous play

example.en: We rented a romantic comedy.
example.es: Alquilamos una comedia romántica.

definition: pursue quickly

alternatives.definition: A groove cut in an object; a slot: the chase for the quarrel on a crossbow.

(architecture) A trench or channel or other encasement structure for encasing (archaically spelled enchasing) drainpipes or wiring; a hollow space in the wall of a building encasing ventilation ducts, chimney flues, wires, cables or plumbing.

example.en: I think it's a wild goose chase.
example.es: Creo que es perseguir un imposible.

definition: The act of storing goods; the state of being stored.

alternatives.definition: An object or place in which something is stored.
The price charged for storing goods.

example.en: They said storage costs were too high.
example.es: Dijeron que los costos de almacenamiento eran demasiado altos.

definition: All of space and everything that exists in it, including stars and planets.

example.en: Tom believes that the universe really has eleven dimensions.
example.es: Tom cree que el universo de verdad tiene once dimensiones.

definition: Causing horror; terrible; shocking.

example.en: I'll get you out of this horrible situation.
example.es: Te sacaré de este horrible trance.

definition: a farm animal

alternatives.definition: A timid, shy person who is easily led by others.

example.en: He is the black sheep of the family.
example.es: Es la oveja negra de la familia.

definition: a person who loves someone

example.en: I'm a lover of beauty in all its forms.
example.es: Soy un amante de la belleza en todas sus formas.

definition: (zoology) A medium-sized rodent belonging to the genus Rattus.

alternatives.definition: (informal) An informant or snitch.
(informal) A scab: a worker who acts against trade union policies.

example.en: I killed the rat with a stick.
example.es: Maté a la rata con una vara.

definition: a painting of a person

example.en: The portrait had a dark background.
example.es: El retrato tenía un fondo oscuro.

definition: not guilty

example.en: If he is innocent, then his wife is guilty.
example.es: Si él es inocente, entonces su esposa es culpable.

definition: A replacement or stand-in for something that achieves a similar result or purpose.

alternatives.definition: (sports) A player who is available to replace another if the need arises, and who may or may not actually do so.
To use in place of something else, with the same function.

example.en: I don't like the substitute teacher.
example.es: No me agrada el profesor sustituto.

definition: Something added; especially, such an addition added to make up for a deficiency.

alternatives.definition: (geometry) An angle that, when added to a given angle, makes 180°; a supplementary angle.
To provide or make a supplement to something.

example.en: There is a 25 euro supplement for the high speed AVE train.
example.es: Hay un suplemento de veinticinco euros para el AVE.

definition: The result of adjusting something; a small change; a minor correction; a modification or alteration

example.en: Give me five minutes to finish the last adjustments.
example.es: Dame cinco minutos para completar los últimos ajustes.

definition: In accordance with reason.

alternatives.definition: Quite; fairly; satisfactorily.

example.en: Tom is looking for a reasonably-priced used car.
example.es: Tom está buscando un coche de segunda mano con un precio razonable.

definition: A device which separates a suspended, dissolved, or particulate matter from a fluid, solution, or other substance; any device that separates one substance from another.

alternatives.definition: To sort, sift, or isolate.
To pass through a filter or to act as though passing through a filter.

example.en: It's necessary to clean the filter.
example.es: Es necesario limpiar el filtro.

definition: Capable of being flexed or bent without breaking; able to be turned or twisted without breaking.

example.en: I have a flexible schedule.
example.es: Tengo un horario flexible.

definition: existing in thought

alternatives.definition: An abridgement or summary of a longer publication.
An abstraction; an abstract term; that which is abstract.

example.en: The theory is too abstract for me.
example.es: La teoría es demasiado abstracta para mí.

definition: A pavilion or portable lodge consisting of skins, canvas, or some strong cloth, stretched and sustained by poles, used for sheltering people from the weather.

example.en: This is a good place to pitch a tent.
example.es: Este es un buen lugar para levantar una carpa.

definition: exact and accurate

alternatives.definition: (nonstandard, European Union, _, documents, transitive) To make or render precise; to specify.

example.en: Be more precise.
example.es: Sé más preciso.

definition: Far off (physically, logically or mentally).

example.en: We can see distant objects with a telescope.
example.es: Con el telescopio se pueden ver objetos lejanos.

definition: A person whom one does not know; a person who is neither a friend nor an acquaintance.

alternatives.definition: An outsider or foreigner.

example.en: He treats me as if I am a stranger.
example.es: Él me trata como si fuera un extraño.

definition: partial darkness

alternatives.definition: Something that blocks light, particularly in a window.
A very small degree of a quantity, or variety of meaning

example.en: It was cool in the shade of the trees.
example.es: Estaba fresco bajo la sombra de los árboles.

definition: a seed of a cereal plant

alternatives.definition: The crops from which grain is harvested.
A linear texture of a material or surface.

example.en: There isn't a grain of truth in what he says.
example.es: No hay ni una pizca de verdad en lo que él dice.

definition: To place on or into a physical location.

example.en: They decided to situate the school near the station.
example.es: Decidieron situar la escuela cerca de la estación.
example.attribution: Original example · English Learning, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0

definition: (ambitransitive) To prepare a summary of (something).

example.en: Could you please summarize the pertinent points?
example.es: ¿Podrías por favor compendiar los puntos pertinentes?

definition: jump

alternatives.definition: (calendar) Intercalary, bissextile.
The act of leaping or jumping.

example.en: Look before you leap.
example.es: Mira antes de saltar.

definition: A quick breaking or cracking sound or the action of producing such a sound.

alternatives.definition: The act of snapping the fingers; making a sound by pressing a finger against the thumb and suddenly releasing to strike the hand.
(informal) A photograph; a snapshot.

example.en: I made a snap judgment.
example.es: Emití un juicio precipitado.

definition: An event that is likely to occur.

example.en: The probability of Tom being punished is very small.
example.es: La probabilidad de que Tom sea castigado es muy pequeña.

definition: material made from animal skin

example.en: My new pair of shoes are made of leather.
example.es: Mi nuevo par de zapatos es de cuero.

definition: Doubt; the condition of being uncertain or without conviction.

example.en: Last year was a period of economic uncertainty.
example.es: El año pasado fue un período de incertidumbre económica.

definition: Make a serious promise or declare that something is true.

example.en: Tom made me swear not to say anything.
example.es: Tom me hizo jurar que no diría nada.

definition: a person who has fled their country

example.en: Tom is a refugee.
example.es: Tom es un refugiado.

definition: (from the perspective of one on a body of water) Land, usually near a port.

example.en: We walked along the shore of the lake.
example.es: Paseamos por la orilla del lago.

definition: Occurring every month.

alternatives.definition: Every month.

example.en: He is paid a handsome monthly salary.
example.es: Se le paga un salario mensual atractivo.

definition: To be made up of; to consist of (especially a comprehensive list of parts).

alternatives.definition: (sometimes, proscribed, usually in the passive) To compose; to constitute.

example.en: Tourism, retail sales, and finance comprise more than three-quarters of GDP.
example.es: El turismo, las ventas al por menor y las finanzas abarcan más de tres cuartas partes del PIB.

definition: Agitation of thoughts; conflicting passions.

alternatives.definition: To disturb the relative position of the particles (of a liquid or similar) by passing an object through it.
To emotionally affect; to touch, to move.

example.en: Stir the paint with a stick.
example.es: Revolvé la pintura con un palo.

definition: The state of being excited (emotionally aroused).

example.en: In all the excitement, I forgot to eat.
example.es: Con toda la emoción, olvidé comer.

definition: A deep, prolonged audible inhale and exhale of breath; as when fatigued, frustrated, grieved, or relieved; the act of sighing.

alternatives.definition: To inhale a larger quantity of air than usual, and immediately expel it; to make a deep single audible respiration, especially as the result or involuntary expression of fatigue, exhaustion, grief, sorrow, frustration, or the like.

example.en: The old woman smiled with a sigh of relief.
example.es: La anciana sonrió con un suspiro de alivio.

definition: The period of time this condition prevails.

example.en: Is it safe to eat raw fish during pregnancy?
example.es: ¿Es seguro comer pescado crudo durante el embarazo?

definition: Serving as an experiment; serving to experiment.

example.en: The first point that requires clarification is that the design was purely experimental.
example.es: El primer punto que requiere aclaración es que el diseño fue puramente experimental.

definition: Of, pertaining to, characteristic of, or organized along the lines of an institution.

example.en: The project needs institutional support to continue.
example.es: El proyecto necesita apoyo institucional para continuar.
example.attribution: Original example · English Learning, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0

definition: A thin, broad piece cut off.

alternatives.definition: A plate of iron with a handle, forming a kind of chisel, or a spadelike implement, variously proportioned, and used for various purposes, as for stripping the planking from a vessel's side, for cutting blubber from a whale, or for stirring a fire of coals; a slice bar; a peel; a fire shovel.
(medicine) A section of image taken of an internal organ using MRI (magnetic resonance imaging), CT (computed tomography), or various forms of x-ray.

example.en: Tom spread some strawberry jam on a slice of bread.
example.es: Tom untó un poco de mermelada de fresa sobre una rebanada de pan.

definition: To go somewhere indirectly or at varying speeds; to move in a curved path.

alternatives.definition: Of the mind, to lose focus or clarity of argument or attention.

example.en: Wolves wander in the woods.
example.es: Los lobos deambulan por el bosque.

definition: a group of countries

example.en: They built their empire in Peru about five hundred years ago.
example.es: Ellos construyeron su imperio en Perú hace aproximadamente quinientos años.

definition: Accordingly, therefore (implying a logical connection or deduction), consequently.

example.en: Subsequently, she started screaming and breaking vases. I, in turn, nonchalantly left the apartment, and went to have tea with Mary.
example.es: Posteriormente ella comenzó a gritar y a romper floreros. Yo, en cambio, tranquilamente abandoné el apartamento y me fui a tomar una taza de té con Mary.

definition: mild and kind

alternatives.definition: Tender and amiable; of a considerate or kindly disposition.
Docile and easily managed.

example.en: Please be gentle.
example.es: Por favor, sé suave.

definition: The act of attending; the state of being present; presence.

example.en: Your attendance will affect your final grade.
example.es: Vuestra asistencia influirá en vuestra calificación final.

definition: The state or right of owning something.

example.en: They disputed the ownership of the land for years.
example.es: Se disputaron la propiedad de las tierras durante años.

definition: (UK) A certificate, diploma, or degree awarded after successful completion of a course, training, or exam.

alternatives.definition: A clause or condition which qualifies something; a modification, a limitation.

example.en: Proper qualifications are required for the position.
example.es: Se requieren calificaciones apropiadas para el puesto.

definition: To halt something temporarily.

example.en: The President suspended the constitution and imposed martial law.
example.es: El presidente suspendió la constitución e impuso la ley marcial.

definition: In good working order.

alternatives.definition: Useful; serving a purpose, fulfilling a function.

example.en: Application developers decided to use a functional programming language.
example.es: Los desarrolladores de la aplicación decidieron usar un lenguaje de programación funcional.

definition: Done, given, or acting of one's own free will.

example.en: Participation is voluntary and free of charge.
example.es: La participación es voluntaria y gratuita.

definition: light in color

alternatives.definition: Feeble, faint.
(heraldiccharge) A vertical band down the middle of a shield.

example.en: Tom looks pale. Is anything the matter with him?
example.es: Tom se ve pálido. ¿Le pasa algo?

definition: A discolored spot or area caused by spillage or other contact with certain fluids or substances.

alternatives.definition: A blemish on one's character or reputation.
A substance used to soak into a surface and colour it.

example.en: The stain disappeared after we washed the shirt.
example.es: La mancha desapareció después de que lavásemos la camisa.

definition: a person trained in sports

alternatives.definition: An exceptionally physically fit person.

example.en: It seems that Tom used to be a great athlete.
example.es: Parece que Tom era un gran atleta.

definition: relating to living matter

example.en: Tom and Mary own a small organic farm.
example.es: Tomás y María tienen una pequeña granja.

definition: Such an organ, as taken from animals and used for food (especially from cows).

alternatives.definition: The pole of a towed or drawn vehicle or farm implement (e.g., trailer, cart, plow, harrow), by which it is pulled; for example, the pole of an ox cart, to the end of which the oxen are yoked.
In a shoe, the flap of material that goes between the laces and the foot (so called because it resembles a tongue in the mouth).

example.en: His name is on the tip of my tongue.
example.es: Tengo su nombre en la punta de la lengua.

definition: (computing) A program that provides services to other programs or devices, either in the same computer or over a computer network.

example.en: I can't check my mail. The server is down.
example.es: El servidor está caído y no puedo leer mi correo.

definition: Of, relating to, or having structure.

example.en: The nephron is the kidney's basic structural and functional unit, responsible for blood purification.
example.es: El nefrón es una unidad estructural y funcional básica del riñón, responsable de la purificación de la sangre.

definition: (Internet) A collection of interlinked web pages on the World Wide Web that are typically accessible from the same base URL and reside on the same server.

example.en: How can I upload a photo to your website?
example.es: ¿Cómo puedo subir una foto a tu página web?

definition: a silly person

alternatives.definition: (tarot, often, capitalized, _, Fool) A particular card in a tarot deck, representing a jester.

example.en: He often makes mistakes, but he is no fool.
example.es: A menudo él comete errores, pero no es tonto.

definition: Along the side; by the side; side by side; abreast.

alternatives.definition: Together with or at the same time.
alternatives.meaning: al lado de; junto a; yunto a

example.en: The two houses stand alongside of each other.
example.es: Las dos casas están al lado la una de la otra.

definition: To bring together as one.

alternatives.definition: (reciprocal) To come together as one.

example.en: The two companies plan to unite.
example.es: Las dos empresas planean fusionarse.

definition: In a gentle manner; to a gentle degree.

example.en: He put his hand gently on her shoulder.
example.es: Él puso gentilmente su mano sobre su hombro.

definition: To reckon, calculate.

example.en: Scientists can easily compute the distance between planets.
example.es: Los científicos fácilmente pueden calcular la distancia entre planetas.

definition: To move an object over, maintaining contact, with the intention of removing some substance from the surface. (Compare rub.)

alternatives.definition: To make (a joint, as between pieces of lead pipe), by surrounding the junction with a mass of solder, applied in a plastic condition by means of a rag with which the solder is shaped by rubbing.

example.en: Wipe that smirk off your face.
example.es: Borra esa sonrisa boba de tu cara.

definition: Having an unusually strange character or behaviour.

example.en: I don't think that it's weird at all.
example.es: No creo que sea raro en absoluto.

definition: look steadily

alternatives.definition: To stare intently or earnestly.

example.en: I quickly turned my gaze to the door.
example.es: Rápidamente dirigí mi mirada a la puerta.

definition: To grow weak; to lose strength; to decay; to perish gradually; to wither, as a plant.

alternatives.definition: To lose freshness, color, or brightness; to become faint in hue or tint; hence, to be wanting in color.
To sink away; to disappear gradually; to grow dim; to vanish.

example.en: Old soldiers never die. They just fade away.
example.es: Los viejos soldados nunca mueren. Simplemente se desvanecen.

definition: expel air from lungs

example.en: Tom started to cough.
example.es: Tom se puso a toser.

definition: (sciences) A tentative conjecture explaining an observation, phenomenon or scientific problem and that can be tested by further observation, investigation, and/or experimentation.

example.en: This is just a hypothesis.
example.es: Esto es solo una hipótesis.

definition: relating to a king or queen

example.en: The royal family lives in the Imperial Palace.
example.es: La familia real vive en el Palacio Imperial.

definition: Of or relating to theory; abstract; not empirical.

example.en: He's studying to become a theoretical physicist.
example.es: Está estudiando para ser físico teórico.

definition: a hanging cloth

alternatives.definition: A similar piece of cloth that separates the audience and the stage in a theater.

example.en: Tom knew that Mary was hiding behind the curtain.
example.es: Tom sabía que Mary estaba oculta tras la cortina.

definition: the head of a city

example.en: Do you know who the mayor of Boston is?
example.es: ¿Sabes quién es el alcalde de Boston?

definition: The state of being dark; lack of light; the absolute or comparative absence of light.

alternatives.definition: Gloom; gloominess; depression.

example.en: Our eyes take time to adjust to the darkness.
example.es: Nuestros ojos requieren tiempo para adaptarse a la oscuridad.

definition: The sister or sister-in-law of one’s parent.

example.en: My uncle is slim, but my aunt is fat.
example.es: Mi tío está delgado, pero mi tía está gorda.

definition: A series of games; either the same game played many times, or a succession of games related by a single theme; played competitively to determine a single winning team or individual.

example.en: He won the first prize at the chess tournament.
example.es: Él ganó el primer premio en el torneo de ajedrez.

definition: The act of signing up or registering for something.

alternatives.definition: The location where guests register, especially with a hotel.

example.en: Registration starts at 2:30.
example.es: El registro empieza a las dos y media.

definition: A part broken off; a small, detached portion; an imperfect part, either physically or not

alternatives.definition: To break apart.

example.en: According to the popular “nebular hypothesis,” the solar system was formed as the result of the gravitational collapse of a fragment of a giant molecular cloud.
example.es: Según la popular "hipótesis nebular", el sistema solar se formó como resultado del colapso gravitacional de un fragmento de una gigante nube molecular.

definition: Someone who listens, especially to a speech or a broadcast.

example.en: Tom is a good listener.
example.es: Tom es bueno escuchando.

definition: The act of immigrating; the passing or coming into a country of which one is not native born for the purpose of permanent residence.

example.en: America’s immigration system is broken.
example.es: El sistema de inmigración de los Estados Unidos está dañado.

definition: Sensitive or painful to the touch.

alternatives.definition: (rail transport) A railroad car towed behind a steam engine to carry fuel and water.
A means of payment such as a check or cheque, cash or credit card.

example.en: Tom gave Mary a tender kiss.
example.es: Tom le dio un beso tierno a Mary.

definition: (physics) A measure of the mass of matter contained by a unit volume.

example.en: The density of water depends on the temperature.
example.es: La densidad del agua depende de la temperatura.

definition: Displeasing to the eye; aesthetically unpleasing.

example.en: Tom thought the watch Mary had given him was ugly.
example.es: Tom pensó que el reloj que le regaló Mary era feo.

definition: A self-contained component of a system, often interchangeable, which has a well-defined interface to the other components.

example.en: The crew can enter the underwater vehicle using a plug-in module.
example.es: La tripulación puede entrar al vehículo sumergido usando un módulo de inserción.

definition: In a faithful manner.

example.en: He served his king faithfully.
example.es: Él sirvió fielmente a su rey.

definition: the season before winter

example.en: These green leaves turn red or yellow in autumn.
example.es: Estas hojas verdes se vuelven rojas o amarillas en otoño.

definition: the side of the face

alternatives.definition: (anatomy, informal, usually, in the plural) The lower part of the buttocks that is often exposed beneath very brief underwear, swimwear, or extremely short shorts.
(figurative, informal, uncountable) Impudence.

example.en: Tom leaned over and kissed Mary on the cheek.
example.es: Tom se inclinó y besó a Mary en la mejilla.

definition: The act or process of (physically or figuratively) attaching.

alternatives.definition: The means by which something is physically attached.
(legal) Taking a person's property to satisfy a court-ordered debt.

example.en: She had a great attachment to that old house.
example.es: Ella era muy apegada a esa vieja casa.

definition: A thing that holds.

alternatives.definition: A person who temporarily or permanently possesses something.

example.en: She uncovers the little plastic tortilla holder so gracefully. It's little things like that that are so cute about people.
example.es: Ella destapa la tartera donde guarda la tortilla tan elegantemente... Esos detalles hacen a la gente tierna.

definition: Of or pertaining to the sun; proceeding from the sun

example.en: How many planets are there in our solar system?
example.es: ¿Cuántos planetas hay en nuestro sistema solar?

definition: A smile in which the lips are parted to reveal the teeth.

alternatives.definition: To smile, parting the lips so as to show the teeth.

example.en: I stifled a grin.
example.es: Contuve una sonrisa burlona.

definition: a flower

alternatives.definition: A en given name.
A shrub of the genus Rosa, with red, pink, white or yellow flowers.

example.en: There is a red rose in the vase.
example.es: Hay una rosa roja en el florero.

definition: (grammar, narrowly) A word that functions as the name of a specific object or set of objects, such as person, animal, place, word, thing, phenomenon, substance, quality, or idea: one of the basic parts of speech in many languages, including English.

example.en: In this case, the adjective goes before the noun.
example.es: En este caso el adjetivo va antes del nombre.

definition: Happening by good luck or favorable chance.

example.en: You are very fortunate that you have such friends.
example.es: Eres muy afortunado de tener tales amigos.

definition: Acceptable or satisfactory; an informal spelling of all right.

example.en: Are you sure you'll be alright here by yourself?
example.es: ¿Estás segura de que estarás bien aquí tú sola?

definition: unwilling to work

example.en: The trouble with him is that he is lazy.
example.es: El problema con él es que es perezoso.

definition: used as a greeting

alternatives.definition: A call for response if it is not clear if anyone is present or listening, or if a telephone conversation may have been disconnected.

example.en: I thought Tom would stop by to say hello.
example.es: Pensé que Tom pasaría a decir hola.

definition: (by extension) Any strong desire or need.

alternatives.definition: To be in need of food.
(figuratively, intransitive, usually, _, with 'for' or 'after') To have a desire (for); to long; to yearn.

example.en: She had some cookies to stay her hunger until dinner.
example.es: Toma algunas galletas para calmar el hambre hasta la cena.

definition: To provide for compensation if some specified risk occurs. Often agreed by policy (contract) to offer financial compensation in case of an accident, theft or other undesirable event.
