example.en: I won't be able to stay in such a frustrating job.
example.es: No podré seguir en este trabajo tan frustrante.

definition: Alert, awake; with one's mental faculties active.

example.en: People are more conscious nowadays and choose healthy food.
example.es: La gente está más consciente hoy en día y elige comida sana.

definition: a solemn request

alternatives.definition: An act of praying.
One who prays.

example.en: Let's say a prayer before dinner.
example.es: Hagamos una oración antes de cenar.

definition: (medicine) To order (a drug or medical device) for use by a particular patient (under licensed authority).

example.en: You should go to specialist, for now I will prescribe you medicine.
example.es: Debería ir a un especialista, pero le puedo prescribir una medicina ahora.

definition: of lower rank

example.en: I'm a junior high school student.
example.es: Soy estudiante de secundaria.

definition: Voluntary agreement or permission.

alternatives.definition: To express willingness, to give permission.

example.en: I need your consent to test you for COVID-19.
example.es: Necesito tu consentimiento para hacerte la prueba de la COVID-19.

definition: A usually alphabetized and explained collection of words e.g. of a particular field, or prepared for a specific purpose, often for learning.

example.en: Do you know a good way to memorize new vocabulary?
example.es: ¿Conoces algún buen método de memorizar vocabulario nuevo?

definition: Of or relating to administering or administration.

example.en: Juan is the bank's administrative manager.
example.es: Juan es el gerente administrativo del banco.

definition: A public gathering or mass meeting that is not mainly a protest and is organized to inspire enthusiasm for a cause.

alternatives.definition: (motor racing) An event in which competitors drive through a series of timed special stages at intervals. The winner is the driver who completes all stages with the shortest cumulative time.
To collect, and reduce to order, as troops dispersed or thrown into confusion; to gather again; to reunite.

example.en: The new political parties are rally lovers and populists, but not at all democratic.
example.es: Los nuevos partidos políticos son asamblearios y populistas, pero nada democráticos.

definition: Intensity of feeling; excited interest or eagerness.

example.en: I can't say I share your enthusiasm for the idea.
example.es: No puedo decir que comparta tu entusiasmo por la idea.

definition: (proscribed) Pertaining to finance and money in general; financial.

example.en: The fiscal austerity may lead to an overkill of the economy.
example.es: La austeridad fiscal nos puede llevar a la destrucción de la economía.

definition: The act (action) or process of punishing, imposing and/or applying a sanction, typically by an authority or a person in authority (for example: a parent or teacher), especially when disappointed or dissatisfied with the behavior or actions of a child, student, or someone else being looked after.

example.en: We won't be able to escape punishment this time.
example.es: Esta vez no podremos escapar del castigo.

definition: for the duration of the night

alternatives.definition: Occurring between dusk and dawn.
(figurative) In a very short (but unspecified) amount of time.
alternatives.meaning: de la noche a la mañana; de un día para otro

example.en: The meat can be thawed by leaving it in the fridge overnight.
example.es: La carne se puede descongelar dejándola en el frigo durante la noche.

definition: Intoxicated as a result of excessive alcohol consumption, usually by drinking alcoholic beverages.

alternatives.definition: A drunken state.

example.en: Tom is usually drunk by this time of day.
example.es: Como a esta hora comúnmente Tom está borracho.

definition: A distance in space.

example.en: The trees are planted at intervals of thirty meters.
example.es: Los árboles están plantados a espacios de treinta metros.

definition: a domestic animal kept for pleasure

alternatives.definition: (figurative) Favourite; cherished; the focus of one's attention.
To stroke or fondle (an animal).

example.en: A pet monkey would be a lot of work.
example.es: Un mono de mascota supondría mucho trabajo.

definition: A person or thing that takes the place of another; a substitute.

example.en: History develops through the replacement of the old by the new.
example.es: La historia se desarrolla a través del reemplazo de lo viejo por lo nuevo.

definition: a possible situation

example.en: That scenario is unlikely.
example.es: Ese escenario es poco probable.

definition: A firmly held belief.

alternatives.definition: The state of being wholly convinced.

example.en: Tom has at least one conviction for drunken driving.
example.es: Tom tiene al menos una condena por conducir en estado de ebriedad.

definition: A vent or similar passage to allow the escape of something.

alternatives.definition: Something which allows for the release of one's desires.
A river that runs out of a lake.
alternatives.meaning: desembocadura; río que nace en un lago

example.en: He needs a more productive outlet for his anger.
example.es: Él necesita una salida más productiva para su furia.

definition: A professional who designs buildings or other structures, or who prepares plans and superintends construction.

example.en: He is the greatest architect that has ever lived.
example.es: Él es el mayor arquitecto que ha vivido jamás.

definition: A debate or discussion of opposing opinions; (generally) strife.
meaning: controversia; cuestión batallona; manzana de la discordia

example.en: Tom doesn't like controversy.
example.es: A Tom no le gustan las controversias.

definition: One who, or that which, provides a service, commodity, or the means for subsistence.

example.en: Contact your internet provider if the connection fails.
example.es: Contacta a tu proveedor de internet si falla la conexión.
example.attribution: Original example · English Learning, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0

definition: A place where waste or garbage is left; a ground or place for dumping ashes, refuse, etc.; a disposal site.

alternatives.definition: To discard; to get rid of something one no longer wants.
To sell below cost or very cheaply; to engage in dumping.

example.en: Don't dump garbage here.
example.es: No tires basura aquí.

definition: To force, constrain, or coerce.

example.en: The court can compel a witness to attend.
example.es: El tribunal puede obligar a un testigo a asistir.
example.attribution: Original example · English Learning, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0

definition: an intense feeling of fear

example.en: Does Tom enjoy watching horror movies?
example.es: ¿A Tom le gusta ver películas de horror?

definition: fighting

alternatives.definition: To fight (with); to struggle for victory (against).

example.en: Tom died in combat.
example.es: Tom murió en combate.

definition: alleviate pain

alternatives.definition: To ease (someone, a part of the body etc.) or give relief from physical pain or discomfort.

example.en: She stretched to relieve the stiffness in her back.
example.es: Ella se estiró para aliviar su rigidez de espalda.

definition: Critical assessment of a process or activity or of their results.

alternatives.definition: (electronics, cybernetics, control theory, ) The part of an output signal that is looped back into the input to control or modify a system.
(amplification) The high-pitched howling noise heard when there is a loop between a microphone and a speaker.

example.en: Thanks for your feedback. Now if you excuse me, I'm... going to cry now.
example.es: Gracias por sus críticas. Ahora si me disculpa...voy a llorar.

definition: cause to become

alternatives.definition: (computer graphics) A digital image produced by rendering a model.
(ditransitive) To cause to become.

example.en: She came completely naked into the room, rendering him speechless.
example.es: Ella entró completamente desnuda a la habitación, dejándolo mudo.

definition: the upper interior surface

example.en: She was standing on a ladder painting the ceiling.
example.es: Ella estaba parada en una escalera pintando el techo.

definition: Advertising or other activity designed to rouse public interest in something.

example.en: We don't want any bad publicity.
example.es: No queremos publicidad negativa.

definition: of acceptable quality

example.en: I want Tom to have a decent life.
example.es: Quiero que Tom tenga una vida decente.

definition: Fairness, impartiality, or justice as determined in light of "natural law" or "natural right".

alternatives.definition: (business) Ownership, especially in terms of net monetary value of some business.
(accounting) Ownership interest in a company as determined by subtracting liabilities from assets.

example.en: There is but one law for all, namely, that law which governs all law, the law of our Creator, the law of humanity, justice, equity — the law of nature, and of nations.
example.es: Solo hay una ley para todos, a saber, esta es la ley que gobierna todas las leyes, la ley de nuestro Creador, la ley de la humanidad, de la justicia y de la igualdad: la ley de la naturaleza y de las naciones.

definition: a problem designed to test ingenuity

alternatives.definition: A riddle.
To perplex, confuse, or mystify; to cause (someone) to be faced with a mystery, without answers or an explanation.

example.en: I can't figure out how to solve the puzzle.
example.es: No se me ocurre cómo resolver el rompecabezas.

definition: a place of burial

alternatives.definition: Characterised by a dignified sense of seriousness; not cheerful.
Low in pitch, tone etc.

example.en: Tom has one foot in the grave.
example.es: Tom tiene un pie en la tumba.

definition: fail to notice

alternatives.definition: A vista or point that gives a view down toward something else.

example.en: Shouldn't you overlook his indiscretions and forgive him?
example.es: ¿No deberías pasar por alto sus indiscreciones y perdonarle?

definition: a covering for the face

alternatives.definition: (computer graphics) A two-color (black and white) bitmap generated from an image, used to create transparency in the image.
To cover (the face or something else), in order to conceal the identity or protect against injury; to cover with a mask or visor.

example.en: Tom was wearing a mask to conceal his identity.
example.es: Tom llevaba puesto una máscara para ocultar su identidad.

definition: The highest point of a hill, mountain, or similar geographical feature.

example.en: We took a long hike up to the summit.
example.es: Dimos la gran andada para llegar a la cumbre.

definition: Not expected, anticipated or foreseen.

example.en: For Tom, getting fired was an unexpected shock.
example.es: Para Tom, ser despedido fue un shock inesperado.

definition: The circumference of, or distance around, any space; the measure of a line around an area.

example.en: A resistor fell off the circuit board.
example.es: Se cayó una resistencia de la placa de circuitos.

definition: The suspended condensate (cloud) formed by water vapour when it encounters colder air.

alternatives.definition: To cook with steam.
alternatives.meaning: cocer al vapor; cocinar al vapor; vaporar

example.en: Steam is coming out of the engine.
example.es: Está saliendo vapor del motor.

definition: Continuing, permanent, lasting.

alternatives.definition: Presently or currently happening; being in progress.

example.en: The project is ongoing.
example.es: El proyecto está en marcha.

definition: Of high or especially quick cognitive capacity, bright.

example.en: He is not as intelligent as his older brother.
example.es: No es tan inteligente como su hermano mayor.

definition: to identify by or divide into classes; to categorize

example.en: One can classify books into good ones and bad ones.
example.es: Los libros se pueden clasificar en dos: buenos o malos.

definition: In a correct manner.

example.en: Tom never did learn how to do that correctly.
example.es: Tom nunca aprendió a hacer eso correctamente.

definition: To render unable; to take away an ability of, as by crippling.

alternatives.definition: (chiefly, of a person) To impair the physical or mental abilities of; to cause a serious, permanent injury.
(chiefly, electronics, computing) To deactivate, to make inoperational (especially of a function of an electronic or mechanical device).

example.en: I wish I could figure out how to disable comments on my blog.
example.es: Me gustaría averiguar cómo desactivar comentarios en mi blog.

definition: The act of examining something, often closely.

example.en: The building did not pass a fire inspection.
example.es: El edificio no pasó una inspección de incendios.

definition: A female partner in an unmarried romantic relationship.

alternatives.definition: (somewhat, _, dated) A female friend of a woman or girl.

example.en: I want to buy a gift for my girlfriend.
example.es: Quiero comprarle un regalo a mi novia.

definition: (orthography) A mark or character used in writing, in order to indicate the place of the spoken accent, or to indicate the nature or quality of the vowel marked.

alternatives.definition: To mark emphatically; to emphasize; to accentuate; to make prominent.

example.en: Judging from his accent, he is from Kansai.
example.es: A juzgar por su acento, es de Kansai.

definition: An expert in economics, especially one who studies economic data and extracts higher-level information or proposes theories.

example.en: I'm not an astrologer; I'm an economist.
example.es: No soy astrólogo, soy economista.

definition: throw in various directions

alternatives.definition: (ergative) To (cause to) separate and go in different directions; to disperse.
To deflect (radiation or particles).

example.en: For an idea to germinate and to be fruitful, it is necessary to scatter its seeds in the appropriate season.
example.es: Para que una idea germine y sea fructífera, es necesario esparcir sus semillas en la estación apropiada.

definition: not boastful

alternatives.definition: (especially of behavior or clothing) Intending to avoid the encouraging of sexual attraction in others.

example.en: The older he grew, the more modest he became.
example.es: Cuanto más viejo se hacía, más modesto se volvía.

definition: grab suddenly

alternatives.definition: To take advantage of (an opportunity or circumstance).
To take possession of (by force, law etc.).

example.en: You have no legal right to seize my property.
example.es: Usted no tiene derecho legal a confiscar mi propiedad.

definition: The act of transforming or the state of being transformed.

example.en: Transformation is birth and death at the same time.
example.es: La transformación es nacimiento y muerte al mismo tiempo.

definition: the abode of God

example.en: God created the heaven and the earth.
example.es: Dios creó el cielo y la tierra.

definition: More or most likely to be exposed to the chance of being attacked or harmed, either physically or emotionally.

example.en: Tom is vulnerable.
example.es: Tom es vulnerable.

definition: quick to learn

alternatives.definition: Nimble with hands or body; dexterous; skillful; adept.
Smart, intelligent, or witty; mentally quick or sharp.

example.en: Although he may be clever, he is not wise.
example.es: A pesar de que pueda ser inteligente, no es sabio.

definition: A park where live animals are exhibited.

example.en: How can I get to the zoo from here?
example.es: ¿Cómo puedo ir al zoo desde aquí?

definition: an event causing public outrage

example.en: I don't think Tom was involved in the scandal.
example.es: No creo que Tom estuviera involucrado en el escándalo.

definition: Violence or threats used to pursue political or ideological aims.

example.en: The government is determined to put an end to terrorism.
example.es: El gobierno está decidido a poner fin al terrorismo.

definition: a device storing electrical energy

alternatives.definition: (electrical, electronics, countable) A device used to power electric devices, consisting of one or more electrically connected electrochemical cells or (archaically) electrostatic cells.
(legal) The infliction of unlawful physical violence on a person, legally distinguished from assault, which involves the threat of impending violence.

example.en: I should've left the camera battery recharging.
example.es: Debería haber dejado cargando la batería de la cámara.

definition: a leader of a group

alternatives.definition: To act as captain
To exercise command of a ship, aircraft or sports team.

example.en: They spoke ill of the captain in his absence.
example.es: Hablaron mal del capitán en su ausencia.

definition: The larger part of an organism, composed of tissues that perform similar functions.

alternatives.definition: An official magazine, newsletter, or similar publication of an organization.

example.es: El cirujano le convenció para someterse a un trasplante de órgano.

example.en: Tom threw the drugs into the toilet and flushed it.
example.es: Tom tiró las drogas al retrete y tiró de la cadena.

definition: stop blaming

example.en: Tom wants to forgive his father for abandoning him.
example.es: Tom quiere perdonar a su padre por abandonarlo.

definition: (US politics) Of or pertaining to the Republican Party of the United States.

example.en: Lincoln was a Republican.
example.es: Lincoln fue un republicano.

definition: In a physical manner.

example.en: Generally speaking, men are physically stronger than women.
example.es: Generalmente los hombres son físicamente más fuertes que las mujeres.

definition: A formal binding agreement concluded by subjects of international law, namely, states and international organizations; a convention, a pact.

example.en: It seemed clear the Senate would reject the treaty.
example.es: Parecía claro que el Senado rechazaría el tratado.

definition: a story spread without confirmation

alternatives.definition: Information or misinformation of the kind contained in such claims.

example.en: Tom didn't believe the rumor about Mary and John.
example.es: Tom no creyó el rumor sobre Mary y John.

definition: the development of events

alternatives.definition: The effect, consequence, outcome, or inevitable events predetermined by this cause.

example.en: She had no choice but to accept her fate.
example.es: Ella no tuvo más alternativa que aceptar su destino.

definition: A narrow passageway between fences, walls, hedges or trees.

alternatives.definition: A lengthwise division of roadway intended for a single line of vehicles.
(athletics) A similar division of a racetrack to keep runners apart.

example.en: A fence separates the garden from the lane.
example.es: Una valla separa el jardín de un caminito.

alternatives.definition: To start (something) again that has been stopped or paused from the point at which it was stopped or paused; continue, carry on.
To start again after an interruption or pause.

example.en: Let's resume reading where we left off last week.
example.es: Sigamos leyendo donde nos detuvimos la semana pasada.

definition: Physical or emotional discomfort, suffering, or alarm, particularly of a more acute nature.

alternatives.definition: A cause of such discomfort.
Serious danger.

example.en: You have no idea how distressed she was.
example.es: No tienes ni idea de cuán angustiada estaba.

definition: Consisting of different elements; various.

alternatives.definition: Not the same; different, dissimilar, distinct.

example.en: The world is beautiful because it is diverse.
example.es: El mundo es bello porque es diverso.

definition: The state of being allied.

example.en: In 2012, Mexico formed the Pacific Alliance with Peru, Colombia, and Chile.
example.es: En 2012, México formó La Alianza del Pacífico con Perú, Colombia y Chile.

definition: The act or process of guiding.

alternatives.definition: Advice or counselling on some topic.

example.es: El plan de inmunización consta de cuatro fases y se basa en pruebas científicas, así como en el asesoramiento y la orientación de expertos y el comité de liderazgo en salud pública.

definition: a strong desire to succeed

example.en: Mary wanted to marry a man with ambition.
example.es: Mary se quería casar con un hombre con ambición.

definition: To run away; to escape.

alternatives.definition: To disappear quickly; to vanish; to fleet.

example.en: Whither shall one flee? Where shall I go and abide?
example.es: ¿A dónde ha uno de huir? ¿Dónde deberé ir a morar?

definition: The grounds or property of a school, college, university, business, church, or hospital, often understood to include buildings and other structures.

example.en: I took him to the most expensive restaurant on campus.
example.es: Le llevé al restaurante más caro del campus.

definition: A part of the coast where the land curves inward and is surrounded by sea on three sides.

alternatives.definition: (informal) Ellipsis of San Francisco Bay: a bay of the Pacific Ocean in California, United States.
(especially, of horses) Of a reddish-brown colour.

example.en: A mirage sometimes shows up in Toyama Bay.
example.es: Un espejismo aparece en ocasiones en la bahía de Toyama.

definition: Information which may lead one to a certain point or conclusion.

example.en: You don't have a clue, do you?
example.es: Tú no tienes una pista, ¿oh si?

definition: Obviously true by simple observation.

example.en: It is evident that he did it.
example.es: Es evidente que él lo hizo.

definition: In compliance with or valid under a legal or political constitution.

example.en: It was under these circumstances that the constitutional crisis began.
example.es: Fue bajo estas circunstancias que comenzó la crisis constitucional.

definition: cease doing

alternatives.definition: To set at rest; to free, as from anything harmful or oppressive; to relieve; to clear; to liberate.
To close (an application).

example.en: Do you want to quit?
example.es: ¿Quieres abandonar?

definition: An attribute of a personality (a "personality trait") which predisposes a person to behaviors resulting in human goodness; an admirable quality.

example.en: Patience is a rare virtue these days.
example.es: La paciencia es una rara virtud en estos días.

definition: Of, relating to, or involving technology, especially modern scientific technology.

example.en: Long has it been since the industry has encountered a technological breakthrough, nor even has taken a considerable step forward. This narrowed and shortened the view.
example.es: Mucho tiempo ha pasado desde que la industria ha encontrado un gran avance tecnológico y ni siquiera ha dado un paso considerable hacia adelante. Esto redujo y acortó la perspectiva.

definition: As a rule; frequently; usually.

example.en: What are some foods commonly eaten in America?
example.es: ¿Cuáles son algunos alimentos comúnmente ingeridos en Estados Unidos?

definition: A male partner in an unmarried romantic relationship.

alternatives.definition: A male friend.

example.en: Tom wanted to know if Mary had a boyfriend.
example.es: Tom quería saber si Mary tenía novio.

definition: One who makes observations, monitors or takes notice

example.en: The universe as we know it is a joint product of the observer and the observed.
example.es: El universo tal como lo conocemos es el producto conjunto del observador y lo observado.

definition: The place set for the end of a journey, or to which something is sent; place or point aimed at.

example.en: It is a very popular destination for tourists.
example.es: Es un destino muy popular para los turistas.

definition: Relating to electricity.

example.en: He has an electrical equipment factory.
example.es: Tiene una fábrica de material eléctrico.

definition: An agricultural implement for making holes for sowing seed, and sometimes so formed as to contain seeds and drop them into the hole made.

alternatives.definition: An Old World monkey of West Africa, Mandrillus leucophaeus, similar in appearance to the mandrill, but lacking the colorful face.
The portion of a drilling tool that drives the bit.

example.en: We had a fire drill yesterday.
example.es: Tuvimos un simulacro de incendio ayer.

definition: a heading at the top of an article

alternatives.definition: (journalism) The heading or title of a magazine or newspaper article.

example.en: The headline is somewhat misleading.
example.es: El titular es un poco engañoso.

definition: a round fruit

example.en: Tom ate one apple and Mary ate the other.
example.es: Tom se comió una manzana y María se comió la otra.

definition: (Ireland, often, capitalized) A member of Dáil Éireann, or the title of a member of Dáil Éireann.

alternatives.definition: (US) a law enforcement officer who works for the county sheriff's office; a deputy sheriff or sheriff's deputy; the entry level rank in such an agency.

example.en: He will be my deputy while I am away.
example.es: Él será mi suplente mientras esté fuera.

definition: That which has a distinct existence as an individual unit, often used for organizations which have no physical form.

example.en: The Church is an entity with a lot of accumulated wealth.
example.es: La Iglesia es una entidad que tiene mucha riqueza acumulada.

definition: In many countries, the legislative branch of government, a deliberative assembly or set of assemblies whose elected or appointed members meet to debate the major political issues of the day, make, amend, and repeal laws, authorize the executive branch of government to collect and spend money, and in some cases exercise judicial powers; a legislature.

example.en: Parliament approved the new law last week.
example.es: El Parlamento aprobó la nueva ley la semana pasada.

definition: To make easy or easier.

example.en: Sami's responsibility is to facilitate the investigation.
example.es: La responsabilidad de Sami es la de facilitar la investigación.

definition: The art or science of cultivating the ground, including the harvesting of crops, and the rearing and management of livestock.

example.en: Agriculture was developed more than 10,000 years ago.
example.es: La agricultura fue desarrollada hace más de 10.000 años.

definition: (structural) Any large piece of timber or iron long in proportion to its thickness, and prepared for use.

alternatives.definition: (agricultural) The central bar of a plow, to which the handles and colter are secured, and to the end of which are attached the oxen or horses that draw it.
(physics) A ray or collection of approximately parallel rays emitted from the sun or other luminous body.

example.en: Is the beam solid or hollow?
example.es: ¿Está la viga sólida o hueca?

definition: One who exercises control and direction of a military or naval organization.

example.en: The British commander was forced to surrender.
example.es: El comandante británico fue forzado a rendirse.

definition: Any of various units of mass, originally notionally equal to the contents of a tun, particularly:

alternatives.definition: (figuratively) Any large, excessive, or overwhelming amount of anything.
alternatives.meaning: a base de bien; a cascoporro; a cholón

example.en: This box weighs a ton. What's inside?
example.es: Esta caja pesa una tonelada. ¿Qué hay adentro?

definition: a small piece of material

alternatives.definition: (specifically) A small area, a small plot of land or piece of ground.

example.en: Tom has had a rough patch at work.
example.es: Tom ha tenido una mala racha en su trabajo.

definition: Very quickly and easily prepared.

alternatives.definition: A very short period of time; a moment.
A single, usually precise, point in time.

example.en: Tom drinks instant coffee.
example.es: Tom bebe café instantáneo.

definition: A day that is an exact number of years (to the day) since a given significant event occurred. Often preceded by an ordinal number indicating the number of years.

example.en: Today is our anniversary so let's make this a special dinner.
example.es: Hoy es nuestro aniversario, así que hagamos de esta una cena especial.

definition: Certain other livestock, such as sheep, pigs or goats. Also rarely applied to horses.

example.en: There are about 500 cattle on the ranch.
example.es: Hay sobre 500 cabezas de ganado en el rancho.

definition: In a fortunate manner.

example.es: Afortunadamente, la mordedura de tiburón no dañó ninguna arteria principal.

example.en: Tom wants to cheer Mary up.
example.es: Tom quiere animar a Mary.

definition: Containing homes or intended for people to live in.

example.en: This residential area is comfortable to live in.
example.es: El área residencial es agradable para vivir en ella.

definition: (formal, law) An interest in land granting exclusive use or occupation of real estate for a limited period; a leasehold.

example.en: Is there a clause in the lease regarding that?
example.es: ¿Hay una cláusula en el contrato de arrendamiento con respecto a eso?

definition: To cause, bring about, lead to.

example.en: Nothing could induce him to change his mind.
example.es: Nada podría hacerle cambiar de opinión.

alternatives.definition: (chiefly, transitive) To force sexual intercourse or other sexual activity upon (someone) without their consent.

example.en: The root of the problem lies in our employees' incapacity to internalize the sentiments of the company.
example.es: La raíz del problema estriba en la incapacidad de nuestros empleados en interiorizar el sentimiento de la empresa.

definition: A natural or inherent impulse or behaviour.

example.en: Birds learn to fly by instinct.
example.es: Los pájaros aprenden a volar por instinto.

definition: To provide a place with furniture, or other equipment.

alternatives.definition: To supply or give (something).

example.en: We'll furnish you with everything you need.
example.es: Te proporcionaremos todo lo que necesites.

definition: (legal) The institution of legal proceedings (particularly criminal) against a person.

alternatives.definition: (legal) In many countries, a legal body and institution, usually part of the state apparatus, empowered to perform prosecution. Prosecutor's Office. See Prosecutor.

example.en: The prosecution offered a plea deal.
example.es: La fiscalía ofreció un acuerdo.

definition: The act of affecting or acting upon.

example.en: There is a strong bond of affection between them.
example.es: Hay un fuerte vínculo de afecto entre ellos.

definition: Financial support or assistance, such as a grant.

example.en: She turned down the subsidy that I offered.
example.es: Ella rechazó el subsidio que ofrecí.

definition: (clothing) A knitted or woven covering for the foot.

example.en: There is a hole in his sock.
example.es: Hay un agujero en su calcetín.

definition: Down the stairs.

example.en: Our guest is waiting for us downstairs.
example.es: Nuestro invitado nos está esperando abajo.

definition: Make information known that was previously private.

example.en: I cannot disclose any information about the informant.
example.es: No puedo revelar nada de información acerca del informante.

definition: Of, relating to, or enacted by a parliament.

example.en: Spain, Switzerland and Japan are parliamentary monarchies.
example.es: España, Suecia o Japón, son monarquías parlamentarias.

definition: Exceedingly violent, severe, ferocious, cruel or savage.

example.en: You're going to come up against fierce competition.
example.es: Va usted a tener una competencia feroz.

definition: Affectionate.

alternatives.definition: Indulgent, doting.
Outlandish; foolish; silly.

example.en: He is fond of watching baseball games on TV.
example.es: A él le gusta ver partidos de béisbol en la televisión.

definition: a liquid served with food

alternatives.definition: To add sauce to; to season.

example.en: Tom put too much hot sauce on his pizza.
example.es: Tom le puso demasiada salsa picante a su pizza.

definition: To hide something from view or from public knowledge, to try to keep something secret.

example.en: She tried to conceal her grief at the party.
example.es: Ella trató de ocultar su dolor en la fiesta.

definition: A light meal.

alternatives.definition: To eat a light meal.
To eat between meals.

example.en: I had some custard pudding for an afternoon snack.
example.es: Tengo algo de pudin de natillas para la merienda.

definition: Involving or resembling honey.

alternatives.definition: A sweet, viscous, gold-colored fluid produced from plant nectar by bees, and often consumed by humans.
(figuratively) Something sweet or desirable.

example.en: I always add a spoonful of honey to my tea.
example.es: Siempre le hecho una cucharada de miel a mi té.

definition: a professional cook

alternatives.definition: The head cook of a restaurant or other establishment.

example.en: We have a very good chef.
example.es: Tenemos un muy buen cocinero.

definition: An item in which objects, materials or data can be stored or transported.

example.en: The green container is shaped like an igloo.
example.es: El contenedor verde tiene forma de iglú.

definition: A building for recreational use such as a hunting lodge or a summer cabin.

alternatives.definition: Ellipsis of porter's lodge: a building or room near the entrance of an estate or building, especially (UK, Canada) as a college mailroom.
A local chapter of some fraternities, such as freemasons.

example.en: The tourist asked for lodging for the night.
example.es: El turista preguntaba por alojamiento nocturno.

definition: the act of keeping watch

alternatives.definition: (military) The guards who go the rounds for observation; a detachment whose duty it is to patrol.
To go the rounds along a chain of sentinels; to traverse a police district or beat.

example.en: How many patrol cars do you see?
example.es: ¿Cuántos coches patrulla veis?

definition: formally forbid

example.en: Many countries have passed laws to prohibit people from smoking in public places.
example.es: Muchos países han aprobado leyes prohibiendo a la gente fumar en lugares públicos.

definition: One who receives.

alternatives.definition: (chemistry) The portion of an alembic or other still in which the distilled liquid is collected.

example.en: What a strange message! There is no sender and no recipients either.
example.es: Que mensaje tan raro, no tiene dirección ni remite.

definition: (chiefly, US) Soil or earth.

example.en: Soap helps remove the dirt.
example.es: El jabón ayuda a eliminar la suciedad.

definition: A person or thing that immediately follows another in holding an office or title.

example.en: Your successor has already been chosen.
example.es: Tu sucesor ya ha sido escogido.

definition: The probability of a specified outcome; the chance of something happening; probability; the state or degree of being probable.

example.en: The likelihood of being attacked by a shark is very low.
example.es: La probabilidad de ser atacado por un tiburón es muy baja.

definition: An acknowledgment of gratitude, respect or admiration; an accompanying gift.

example.en: The whole company stood in silence for a few moments, as a tribute to the dead.
example.es: La compañía entera guardó silencio por unos momentos en tributo al muerto.

definition: The power or faculty of apprehending of forming an idea in the mind; the power of recalling a past sensation or perception; the ability to form mental abstractions.

example.en: Tom has no conception of what it's like to be in love.
example.es: Tom no tiene idea lo que es estar enamorado.

definition: A group of delegates.

example.en: A trade delegation has gone to Japan ahead of the Prime Minister to crunch the numbers with their Japanese counterparts.
example.es: Una delegación comercial ha ido a Japón, por delante del primer ministro, para cuadrar los números con sus homólogos japoneses.

definition: An inheritance; property that may be inherited.

alternatives.definition: A tradition; a practice or set of values that is passed down from preceding generations through families or through institutional memory.

example.en: Tom is a heritage speaker of French.
example.es: Tom es un hablante de francés por herencia.

definition: In a severe manner.

example.en: The teacher scolded his students severely.
example.es: El profesor retó severamente a sus estudiantes.

definition: Of or pertaining to demography.

example.en: Among the industrialised nations, only Japan has an older demographic than Italy.
example.es: Entre los países industrializados, solo Japón tiene una demografía más mayor que Italia.

definition: a flying insect

example.en: My mother is busy as a bee every day.
example.es: Todos los días, mi madre anda ocupada como abeja.

definition: (nautical) The fore-and-aft angle of the vessel to the water, with reference to the cargo and ballast; the manner in which a vessel floats on the water, whether on an even keel or down by the head or stern.

alternatives.definition: To reduce slightly; to cut; especially, to remove excess.
To adjust the positions of control surfaces, sometimes using trim tabs, so as to modify or eliminate the aircraft's tendency to pitch, roll, or yaw when the cockpit controls are released.

example.en: I thought I told you to trim your beard.
example.es: Pensé que te había dicho que recortases tu barba.

definition: The study of all life or living matter.

example.en: He's a professor of biology at Harvard.
example.es: Es profesor de biología en Harvard.

definition: To put an end to, especially with force, to crush, do away with; to prohibit, subdue.

alternatives.definition: To restrain or repress, such as laughter or an expression.

example.en: Suppressing one's anger is a virtue.
example.es: Reprimir la ira de uno mismo es una virtud.

definition: A (mostly four-wheeled) lighter vehicle chiefly designed to transport people, generally drawn by horse power.

example.en: Today I saw a horse-drawn carriage amongst the traffic.
example.es: Hoy he visto un carro de caballos entre el tráfico.

definition: The use of a word, phrase, concept, or set of concepts to refer to something other than its literal meaning, invoking an implicit similarity between the thing described and what is denoted by the word, etc., that is used.

example.en: I thought it was just a metaphor.
example.es: Pensé que era solo una metáfora.

definition: Focused on audible sound, as opposed to sight.

example.en: An MP3 file is an audio file.
example.es: Un archivo MP3 es un archivo de audio.

definition: An insect in the order Orthoptera, especially family Gryllidae, that makes a chirping sound by rubbing its wing casings against combs on its hind legs.

alternatives.definition: A variant of the game of darts. See Cricket (darts).

example.en: A caged cricket eats just as much as a free cricket.
example.es: Un grillo enjaulado come tanto como un grillo libre.

definition: not asleep

alternatives.definition: To become conscious after having slept.
To cause (somebody) to stop sleeping.

example.en: I drank a cup of coffee to stay awake.
example.es: Bebí una taza de café para permanecer despierto.

definition: (optics) An object, usually made of glass, that focuses or defocuses the light that passes through it.

alternatives.definition: (anatomy) The transparent crystalline structure in the eye.

example.en: Tom lost a contact lens.
example.es: Tom perdió una lente de contacto.

definition: An act of surrendering, submission into the possession of another; abandonment, resignation.

alternatives.definition: To give oneself up into the power of another, especially as a prisoner; to submit or give in.

example.en: The pirates had no choice but to surrender.
example.es: Los piratas no tuvieron más opción que rendirse.

definition: To enter into; to make way into the interior of; to pierce.

example.en: The notes of that song have a sweet melancholy that penetrates my heart.
example.es: Las notas de esa canción contienen una dulce melancolía que me invade el corazón.

definition: A trip, especially a long one, made by a person or a group of people for a specific purpose

example.en: They went on an expedition to the North Pole.
example.es: Ellos fueron en una expedición al polo norte.

definition: At once; without delay.

example.en: Tom was hit by a truck and died instantly.
example.es: Tom fue atropellado por un camión y murió al instante.

definition: a set of keys

alternatives.definition: To type on a computer keyboard.

example.en: Can you play that chord on the keyboard?
example.es: ¿Puedes tocar ese acorde en el teclado?

definition: To inhabit or to visit frequently (most often used in reference to ghosts).

alternatives.definition: To make uneasy, restless.
To stalk; to follow.

example.en: My past indiscretions are coming back to haunt me.
example.es: Mis pasadas indiscreciones están regresando para perseguirme.

definition: An event or occurrence that signifies an ending.

alternatives.definition: (topology, of a set) The smallest closed set which contains the given set.
The act of shutting; a closing.

example.en: The school's closure was due to the snow.
example.es: El cierre de la escuela fue debido a la niebla.

definition: To live; to reside.

alternatives.definition: To abide; to remain; to continue.

example.en: Don't dwell on your past mistakes!
example.es: ¡Deja de darle vueltas a tus errores pasados!

definition: To cause (someone or something) to be; to bring (someone or something) into existence; to produce or initiate a person or thing.

example.en: Haiku is a poetic form originating in Japan.
example.es: El haiku es una forma de poesía de origen japonés.

definition: A circumstance in which a choice must be made between two or more alternatives that seem equally undesirable.

example.en: This is the dilemma.
example.es: Este es el dilema.

definition: Of or pertaining to a period when a country or territory was a colony.

example.en: In the 15th century, Portugal was a great colonial power.
example.es: En el siglo XV, Portugal fue una gran potencia colonial.

definition: (by extension) To determine the cause of a problem.

example.en: She'll diagnose each person carefully.
example.es: Ella diagnosticará a cada persona cuidadosamente.

definition: To enter by force, usually in order to conquer.

example.en: You must not invade the privacy of others.
example.es: No debes invadir la privacidad de otros.

definition: In an accurate manner; exactly; precisely; without error or defect.

example.en: This work's very accurately done.
example.es: Este trabajo está hecho con mucha exactitud.

definition: A conventional, formulaic, and often oversimplified or exaggerated conception, opinion, or image of (a person or a group of people).

alternatives.definition: To make a stereotype of someone or something, or characterize someone by a stereotype.

example.en: It's an old stereotype.
example.es: Es un viejo estereotipo.

definition: To cause (a person or animal) to recover from a faint; to cause (a person or animal) to return to a state of consciousness.

example.en: How did you manage to revive these orchids?
example.es: ¿Cómo lograste hacer revivir estas orquídeas?

definition: Wood prepared for use in building and carpentry.

alternatives.definition: Used by loggers to warn others that a tree being felled is falling.
alternatives.meaning: fuera abajo; tronco va; árbol va

alternatives.definition: (outside, North America, uncountable) Wood that has been pre-cut and is ready for use in construction.

example.en: Thirty years ago, timber was the main industry here.
example.es: Hace treinta años, la madera de construcción era la industria principal de aquí.

definition: Without use or possibility to be used.

example.en: It's useless. Don't harp on it any longer.
example.es: Es inútil, no machaque usted más.

definition: Well-mannered, civilized.

example.en: It's not polite to speak with your mouth full.
example.es: No es de buena educación hablar con la boca llena.

definition: Of, related to, feeling, showing, or characterized by sympathy.

example.en: The girl and her parents were very sympathetic.
example.es: La chica y sus padres eran muy simpáticos.

definition: That in which one specializes; a chosen expertise or talent; bailiwick.

example.en: This is not my specialty.
example.es: Esta no es mi especialidad.

definition: (modal) With certainty.

example.en: When we think positively, we find solutions everywhere.
example.es: Cuando pensamos positivamente, encontramos soluciones en todas partes.

definition: of a color between red and blue

alternatives.definition: Of a purple hue.

example.en: I like the gray sweater more than the purple one.
example.es: Me gusta más el suéter gris que el morado.

definition: (politics) A district represented by one or more elected officials.

example.en: She represents a rural constituency in parliament.
example.es: Representa una circunscripción rural en el parlamento.
example.attribution: Original example · English Learning, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0

definition: To make better; improve.

alternatives.definition: To make a formal alteration (in legislation, a report, etc.) by adding, deleting, or rephrasing.

example.en: Some people want to amend the constitution.
example.es: Algunas personas quieren corregir la constitución.

definition: A person who dances, either for pleasure or as a profession.

alternatives.definition: The second reindeer of Santa Claus.

example.en: I thought that you wanted to be a dancer.
example.es: Pensé que querías ser bailarina.

definition: (engineering) The quantitative point at which an action is triggered, especially a lower limit.

alternatives.definition: The wage or salary at which income tax becomes due.

example.en: Tom has a high threshold for pain.
example.es: Tom tiene un alto umbral del dolor.

definition: To yield or suffer; to surrender; to grant

example.en: The accountant would not concede the mistake.
example.es: El contable no admitiría el error.

definition: A title or brief explanation attached to an illustration, cartoon, user interface element, etc.

alternatives.definition: (cinematography, television) A piece of text appearing on screen as a subtitle or other part of a film or broadcast, describing dialogue (and sometimes other sound) for viewers who cannot hear.
To add captions to a text or illustration.

example.en: Some signs have a symbol and a separate caption.
example.es: Algunas señales tienen un gráfico y una leyenda aparte.

definition: (materials science) An increase in strain with time; the gradual flow or deformation of a material under stress.

alternatives.definition: (informal, pejorative) Someone creepy (annoyingly unpleasant), especially one who is strange or eccentric.
To grow across a surface rather than upwards.

example.en: Tom is a creep.
example.es: Tom es un lacroso.

definition: Carried out according to a planned, ordered procedure.

example.en: Logic is a systematic method of coming to the wrong conclusion with confidence.
example.es: La lógica es un método sistemático de llegar a la conclusión incorrecta con seguridad.

definition: To overstate, to describe more than the fact.

example.en: She seems to have a tendency to exaggerate things.
example.es: Ella parece tender a exagerar las cosas.

definition: A regularly-shaped slab of clay or other material, affixed to cover or decorate a surface, as in a roof-tile, glazed tile, stove tile, carpet tile, etc.

alternatives.definition: (computing) A rectangular graphic.
Any of various flat cuboid playing pieces used in certain games, such as dominoes, Scrabble, or mahjong.

example.en: A tile fell on my head.
example.es: Se me cayó una teja en la cabeza.

definition: a lawyer who brings charges

alternatives.definition: A prosecuting attorney.
(law) A person, as a complainant, victim, or chief witness, who institutes prosecution in a criminal proceeding.

example.en: Who was the former prosecutor?
example.es: ¿Quién era el antiguo fiscal?

definition: To push or pump (something, especially fluids) into a cavity or passage.

example.en: I have to use a needle to inject this under your skin.
example.es: Tengo que usar esta aguja para inyectarte esto bajo la piel.

definition: causing fear

alternatives.definition: (informal) To a scary extent; scarily.

example.en: It will be scary.
example.es: Será aterrador.

definition: To extinguish the courage of; to dishearten; to depress the spirits of; to deprive of confidence; to deject.

alternatives.definition: To persuade somebody not to do (something).

example.en: Tom doesn't want to discourage Mary.
example.es: Tom no quiere desanimar a Mary.

definition: The process, or the power, of governing; government or administration.

example.en: Good governance requires clear rules and accountability.
example.es: La buena gobernanza requiere reglas claras y rendición de cuentas.
example.attribution: Original example · English Learning, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0

definition: Left complete or whole; not touched, defiled, sullied or otherwise damaged.

example.en: The TV set is intact even though it fell off the desk.
example.es: El televisor está intacto aunque se haya caído del escritorio.

definition: Usually solid excretory product evacuated from the bowels; feces.

alternatives.definition: To excrete (something) through the anus.
To defecate on; to soil through defecating.

example.en: Eat shit — millions of flies cannot be wrong.
example.es: Come mierda (millones de moscas no pueden estar equivocadas).

definition: To work or act together, especially for a common purpose or benefit.

example.en: I'm happy to cooperate.
example.es: Estoy feliz de cooperar.

definition: Make or become wider.

example.en: The gap between the haves and the have nots is widening.
example.es: La brecha entre ricos y pobres se está ampliando.

definition: (manner) In a similar manner.
meaning: del mismo modo; con las mismas; similarmente

alternatives.definition: The same to you; used as a response.

example.en: Likewise, it was nice to meet you.
example.es: Asimismo, era un gusto conocerte.

definition: (anatomy) A large organ in the body that stores and metabolizes nutrients, destroys toxins and produces bile. It is responsible for thousands of biochemical reactions.

example.en: Tom nearly died after eating some raw liver.
example.es: Tom casi murió después de comer un poco de hígado crudo.

definition: One who renders account; one accountable.

example.en: An arrest warrant was issued for the company's accountant.
example.es: Se emitió una orden de detención contra el contable de la compañía.

definition: put off until later

alternatives.definition: To delay or put off an event, appointment, etc.

example.en: We had to postpone the gathering because of rain.
example.es: Tuvimos que posponer la reunión a causa de la lluvia.

definition: A set of clothing (with accessories).

alternatives.definition: (informal) A business or firm.

example.en: What did Tom think of your outfit?
example.es: ¿Qué piensa Tom de tu conjunto?

definition: (entomology) An insect of the order Hemiptera (the “true bugs”).

alternatives.definition: (chiefly, _, computing, engineering, _, jargon) A problem that needs fixing.
(informal) An enthusiasm for something; an obsession.

example.en: We're working to fix this bug.
example.es: Estamos trabajando para reparar ese error.

definition: The state of being dignified or worthy of esteem: elevation of mind or character.

example.en: I've lost my dignity.
example.es: Perdí mi dignidad.

definition: A person's life story, especially one published.

example.en: This biography is fascinating.
example.es: Esta biografía es fascinante.

definition: (pain) A pain or ache in the head.

example.en: What do you do when you have a headache?
example.es: ¿Qué haces cuando tienes dolor de cabeza?

definition: A booklet of printed informational matter, like a pamphlet, often for promotional purposes.

example.en: Could you send me a brochure?
example.es: ¿Podrías enviarme un folleto?

definition: (physiology) Any substance produced by one tissue and conveyed by the bloodstream to another to effect physiological activity.

example.en: Estrogen is a hormone.
example.es: El estrógeno es una hormona.

definition: Slender; thin.

alternatives.definition: To lose weight in order to achieve slimness.

example.en: My uncle is slim, but my aunt is fat.
example.es: Mi tío está delgado, pero mi tía está gorda.

definition: The short thick digit of the hand that for humans has the most mobility and can be made to oppose (moved to touch) all of the other fingers.

example.en: He accidentally hit his thumb with the hammer.
example.es: Él accidentalmente se golpeó en el pulgar con el martillo.

definition: (politics, or, law) Authorized to make a constitution.

alternatives.definition: A resident of an area represented by an elected official, particularly in relation to that official.

example.en: What are the constituents of a gin and tonic?
example.es: ¿Qué ingredientes tiene un gin tonic?

definition: A male deer, antelope, sheep, goat, rabbit, hare, and sometimes the male of other animals such as the hamster, ferret, shad and kangaroo.

alternatives.definition: (US, Australia, NZ, Canada, informal) A dollar (one hundred cents).
To leap upward arching its back, coming down with head low and forelegs stiff, forcefully kicking its hind legs upward, often in an attempt to dislodge or throw a rider or pack.

example.en: He wants the most bang for his buck.
example.es: Él quiere el mejor resultado para su dinero.

definition: Emotional pain, generally arising from misfortune, significant personal loss, bereavement, misconduct of oneself or others, etc.; sorrow; sadness.

example.en: She tried to conceal her grief at the party.
example.es: Ella trató de ocultar su dolor en la fiesta.

definition: (of an, object) Rigid; hard to bend; inflexible.

alternatives.definition: (figurative, of, _, policies and rules and their application and enforcement) Inflexible; rigid.
(of, _, muscles or parts of the body) Painful or more rigid than usual as a result of excessive or unaccustomed exercise.

example.en: I need a shirt with a stiff collar.
example.es: Necesito una camisa de cuello duro.

definition: A price that has been quoted for buying or selling.

example.en: We need a firm quotation by Monday.
example.es: Necesitamos un presupuesto en firme para el lunes.

definition: Of or dealing with languages or cultures derived from Roman influence and Latin: French, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish, Galician, Romanian, Catalan, Occitan, etc.

example.en: Tom and Mary had a whirlwind romance.
example.es: Tom y Mary tuvieron un romance relámpago.

definition: In an independent manner.

example.en: Tom and Bill arrived at the conclusion independently of each other.
example.es: Tom y Bill llegaron a la conclusión independientemente.

definition: A company owned by a parent company or a holding company, also called daughter company or sister company.

example.en: The airline owns a subsidiary that handles cargo.
example.es: La aerolínea posee una filial que gestiona la carga.
example.attribution: Original example · English Learning, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0

definition: A device designed to be placed in the mouth and blown, or driven by steam or some other mechanism, to make a whistling sound.

alternatives.definition: Any high-pitched sound similar to the sound made by whistling.
(ambitransitive) To make a shrill, high-pitched sound by forcing air through the mouth. To produce a whistling sound, restrictions to the flow of air are created using the teeth, tongue and lips.

example.en: The referee blew his whistle to end the match.
example.es: El árbitro sopló su silbato para terminar el partido.

definition: act dishonestly

alternatives.definition: Someone who cheats.
(card games) A card game where the goal is to have no cards remaining in a hand, often by telling lies.

example.en: If I don't cheat, I won't win.
example.es: Si no hago trampa, no ganaré.

definition: attractive

alternatives.definition: Possessing physical features, behaviors, personality traits or other properties that are mainly attributed to infants and small or cuddly animals; e.g. fair, dainty, round, and soft physical features, disproportionately large eyes and head, playfulness, fragility, helplessness, curiosity or shyness, innocence, affectionate behavior.
Lovable, charming, attractive or pleasing, especially in a youthful, dainty, quaint or fun-spirited way.

example.en: You're kind of cute when you're mad.
example.es: Te ves medio lindo cuando te enojas.

definition: The office or role of president.

example.en: Lyndon Johnson took over presidency when John Kennedy was assassinated.
example.es: Lyndon Johnson asumió la presidencia cuando John Kennedy fue asesinado.

definition: Better than average, better than usual; wonderful.

example.en: I've sometimes taken time off work to watch the Super Bowl.
example.es: A veces me he tomado tiempo del trabajo para ver la Super Bowl.

definition: The exercise of sovereign power.

alternatives.definition: To exercise sovereign power, to rule as a monarch.

example.en: Nothing will change for the better under their reign.
example.es: Nada cambiará a mejor bajo su reinado.

definition: As far as can be judged from appearances.

example.en: Seemingly impossible things sometimes happen.
example.es: A veces suceden cosas aparentemente imposibles.

definition: An inland body of standing water, either natural or man-made, that is smaller than a lake.

alternatives.definition: (informal) Chiefly in across the pond: the Atlantic Ocean.

example.en: There are a lot of fish in the pond.
example.es: Hay muchos peces en la laguna.

definition: In an unsatisfactory or unsuccessful way.

example.en: You should not despise a man because he is poorly paid.
example.es: No debes despreciar a un hombre porque esté mal pagado.

definition: 12 oclock in the day

example.es: Al día siguiente no me levanté hasta el mediodía.

definition: A small figure resembling a human being that is used as a toy.

example.en: The little girl has a doll in her hands.
example.es: La niñita tiene una muñeca en sus manos.

definition: A device used to slow or stop the motion of a wheel, or of a vehicle, usually by friction (although other resistive forces, such as electromagnetic fields or aerodynamic drag, can also be used); also, the controls or apparatus used to engage such a mechanism such as the pedal in a car.

alternatives.definition: (chiefly, _, nautical) The handle of a pump.
(textiles) A tool used for breaking flax or hemp.

example.en: One of your brake lights is burned out.
example.es: Una de tus luces de freno se ha fundido.

definition: Having the reddish-brown colour/color of copper.

alternatives.definition: A reddish-brown, malleable, ductile metallic element with high electrical and thermal conductivity, symbol Cu, and atomic number 29.

definition: As individuals, separately, independently.

example.es: Un comité es un grupo de personas que aisladamente nada pueden hacer, pero que como grupo pueden reunirse y decidir que nada puede hacerse.

definition: Of unknown origin.

example.es: ¿Crees que me podrías ayudar esta tarde a podar el jardín?

alternatives.definition: A risky venture.

alternatives.definition: The flowers of the hop plant, dried and used to brew beer etc.

example.es: ¿Cuál es tu artista hip-hop preferido?

alternatives.definition: The flat functional end or piece of a propeller, oar, hockey stick, chisel, screwdriver, skate, etc.

example.es: La hoja estaba muy afilada.

example.es: ¿Estás sugeriendo que se trata de un diseño defectuoso?

definition: Relating to particular persons or things, each to each; particular; own.

example.es: Discutamos los méritos respectivos de los candidatos.

example.es: Tom animó a Mary a comprar un coche híbrido.

(arts) An artist's preliminary sketch.

example.es: ¿Conoces esta caricatura?

definition: A mineral substance made up of small crystals of silica and alumina, that is ductile when moist; the material of pre-fired ceramics.

example.es: El calor del sol endurece la arcilla.

definition: An order or command.

alternatives.definition: To order, command, control.
To speak in order for someone to write down the words.

example.en: Write down what I am going to dictate.
example.es: Escribid lo que voy a dictar.

definition: meaningless language

alternatives.definition: (biochemistry) Resulting from the substitution of a nucleotide in a sense codon, causing it to become a stop codon (not coding for an amino-acid).
An emphatic rejection of something one has just heard and does not believe or agree with.

example.en: I didn't come here to listen to this nonsense.
example.es: Yo no he venido aquí a escuchar tonterías.

definition: The core, central part of something, around which other elements are assembled.

example.en: The atom's nucleus is surrounded by an electron cloud.
example.es: El núcleo del átomo está rodeado de una nube de electrones.

definition: Relating to people aged thirteen to nineteen.

example.en: I have two teenage sons.
example.es: Tengo dos hijos adolescentes.

definition: To make tighter.

alternatives.definition: To become tighter.
(economics) To make money harder to borrow or obtain.

example.en: I have to tighten these bolts.
example.es: Tengo que apretar estos tornillos.

definition: Making a noise, especially a loud unpleasant sound

example.en: I dislike living in such a noisy place.
example.es: No me gusta vivir en un lugar tan ruidoso.

definition: Relating to or in accordance with feminism.

example.en: Mary is a feminist.
example.es: María es feminista.

definition: A member of a marine corps.

alternatives.definition: Belonging to or characteristic of the sea; existing or found in the sea; formed or produced by the sea.
(military, nautical) A soldier, normally a member of a marine corps, trained to serve on board or from a ship.

example.en: Coral reefs attract a variety of beautiful marine life.
example.es: Los arrecifes de coral atraen una variedad preciosa de vida marina.

definition: A protuberance on a level surface.

alternatives.definition: A swelling on the skin caused by illness or injury.

example.en: Tom bumped into Mary on his way to school.
example.es: Tom se topó con Mary cuando iba a la escuela.

definition: A condition of not agreeing or concurring.

example.es: Tom intervino en la disputa de sus colegas.

definition: The state of being banished from one's home or country.

alternatives.definition: Someone who is banished from his home or country.

example.es: Napoleón vivió en la isla Elba en exilio.

definition: An institution or social practice of owning human beings as property, especially for use as forced laborers.

example.en: Slavery was legal in the new Republic of Texas.
example.es: La esclavitud era legal en la nueva República de Texas.

definition: A reason, explanation, or excuse which someone believes provides convincing, morally acceptable support for behavior or for a belief or occurrence.

example.en: You have no justification to say something like that.
example.es: No tienes ninguna justificación para decir algo así.

definition: Pertaining to a symbol.

example.en: It's very symbolic.
example.es: Es muy simbólico.

definition: The state of being mature, ready or ripe; the prime state of productibility and self expression.

example.en: Willingness to take responsibility is a sign of maturity.
example.es: La buena disposición a tomar responsabilidad es una señal de madurez.

definition: A senior member of the Christian clergy who is in charge of a diocese.

alternatives.definition: An English surname originating as an occupation.
(chess) The chess piece denoted ♗ or ♝ which moves along diagonal lines and developed from the shatranj alfil ("elephant") and was originally known as the aufil or archer in English.

example.en: The bishop took pity on the desperate immigrants.
example.es: El obispo se apiadó de los desesperados inmigrantes.

definition: In a general way without considering every detail.

example.en: Broadly speaking, the two proposals are similar.
example.es: En términos generales, las dos propuestas son similares.

definition: Lying next to, close, or contiguous; neighboring; bordering on.

example.en: France is adjacent to Spain.
example.es: Francia es colindante a España.

definition: An individual instance that represents a class; an example.

example.es: Mi biblioteca privada consta de más de mil ejemplares.

definition: Decorative objects worn on the body; also spelled jewellery.

example.en: Tom picked up Mary's jewelry box and opened it.
example.es: Tom cogió la caja de joyas de Mary y la abrió.

definition: (mostly, uncountable) Bread that has been cooked lightly and browned.

alternatives.definition: A proposed salutation (e.g. saying "cheers") while drinking alcohol.
to cook lightly by browning via direct exposure to a fire or other heat source

example.en: Tom ate three eggs and a slice of toast.
example.es: Tom comió tres huevos y una tostada.

definition: Any similar real or imaginary growth or projection such as the elongated tusk of a narwhal, the eyestalk of a snail, the pointed growth on the nose of a rhinoceros, or the hornlike projection on the head of a demon or similar.

alternatives.definition: The hard substance from which animals' horns are made, sometimes used by man as a material for making various objects.
Any of several musical wind instruments.

example.en: Blow the horn so that car will let us pass.
example.es: Toque la bocina para que ese auto nos deje pasar.

definition: (American spelling) Of or relating to behavior.

example.en: These commentators argue that the Pink Panther from the animated cartoons shows the behavioral characteristics of someone on the autism spectrum.
example.es: Estos comentaristas sostienen que la Pantera Rosa de los dibujos animados presenta características comportamentales propias del espectro autista.

definition: One from whom a person is descended, whether on the father's or mother's side, at any distance of time; a progenitor; a forefather; a forebear.

example.en: All humans on Earth are descended from a common ancestor.
example.es: Todos los humanos de la Tierra descienden de un ancestro común.

definition: A body of authoritative officials organized in nested ranks.

example.en: Peer helpers made the teacher's job a lot easier, but established a cruel hierarchy among the students.
example.es: Los ayudantes de los pares hicieron el trabajo del profesor mucho más fácil, pero establecieron una jerarquía cruel entre los estudiantes.

definition: A voluntary gift or contribution for a specific cause.

example.en: Are there any religions that don't permit organ donation?
example.es: ¿Hay alguna religión que no permita la donación de órganos?

definition: To grow or increase stature; to grow vigorously or luxuriantly, to flourish.

example.es: Sólo desean medrar.

definition: A message sent quickly, as a shipment, a prompt settlement of a business, or an important official message sent by a diplomat, government official, military officer, etc.

alternatives.definition: The act of doing something quickly.

example.en: The parcel is ready for dispatch.
example.es: El paquete está listo para ser enviado.

definition: A moderate degree of heat; the sensation of being warm.

alternatives.definition: Friendliness, kindness or affection.

example.es: Los pájaros volaron hacia el sur, en busca del calor.

example.en: The nucleus of a hydrogen atom consists of a single proton. Around this proton orbits a single electron.
example.es: El núcleo de un átomo de hidrógeno consiste en un solo protón. Alrededor de este protón orbita un solo electrón.

definition: The art of using language, especially public speaking, as a means to persuade.

example.es: La belleza es ese misterio hermoso que no descifran ni la psicología ni la retórica.

definition: (architecture) A floor of a building below ground level.

alternatives.definition: (geology) A mass of igneous or metamorphic rock forming the foundation over which a platform of sedimentary rocks is laid.

definition: Of, or relating to mathematics

alternatives.definition: To follow or move in a winding route.

definition: Someone who is unqualified or insufficiently skillful.

example.en: Tom is just an amateur.
example.es: Tom es solo un amateur.

definition: The act of forming into a class or classes; a distribution into groups, as classes, orders, families, etc., according to some common relations or attributes.

example.es: La clasificación no es mi especialidad.

definition: A curved structure that supports the weight of a bridge, roof or wall.

alternatives.definition: leading, leader
Knowing, clever, mischievous.

definition: A disposing of or getting rid of something.

example.es: Tengo mucho dinero a mi disposición.

example.es: El edificio de la derecha es el Archivo Nacional.

example.es: Me comí un limón fresco por la vitamina C.

example.es: La adaptación es la clave para la supervivencia.

definition: Of, pertaining to, or consisting of money.

example.es: Encuentro esta plataforma interesante como complemento a otras herramientas de aprendizaje lingüisticas.

example.es: ¿Oíste el rugido de los leones?

example.es: "Oh cariño," dijo ella, "siéntate, relájate y cierra tus ojos."
