definition: A guarantee that a certain outcome or obligation will be fulfilled; security.

example.en: Unfortunately, Apple does not provide a warranty for accidental damages.
example.es: Lamentablemente, Apple no provee una garantía contra daños accidentales.

definition: A supernatural detriment or hindrance; a bane.

alternatives.definition: To place a curse upon (a person or object).
To call upon divine or supernatural power to send injury upon; to imprecate evil upon; to execrate.

example.en: It is a curse.
example.es: Es una maldición.

definition: The act of moving in a circle, or in a course which brings the moving body to the place where its motion began.

example.en: Blood is the fluid responsible for the circulation of nutrients.
example.es: La sangre es el fluido responsable de la circulación de los nutrientes.

definition: To make as large as possible.

example.en: We arranged the furniture to maximize the available space.
example.es: Organizamos los muebles para aprovechar al máximo el espacio disponible.
example.attribution: Original example · English Learning, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0

definition: To draw or pull something heavy.

alternatives.definition: To carry or transport something, with a connotation that the item is heavy or otherwise difficult to move.

example.en: I'm hauling produce.
example.es: Estoy acarreando productos agrícolas.

definition: In a state of misery: very sad, ill, or poor.

example.en: Because of her, he lived a miserable life.
example.es: Por su culpa, vive una vida miserable.

definition: A structured arrangement of items within certain limits.

alternatives.definition: (publishing) The process of arranging editorial content, advertising, graphics and other information
(engineering) A map or a drawing of a construction site showing the position of roads, buildings or other constructions.

example.en: I've changed my website's layout.
example.es: He cambiado el diseño de mi web.

definition: A short note; a memorandum.

example.en: She sent a memo about the new schedule.
example.es: Envió una nota interna sobre el nuevo horario.
example.attribution: Original example · English Learning, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0

definition: Having sufficient skill, knowledge, ability, or qualifications.

example.en: He was a famous poet and a competent diplomat.
example.es: Era un poeta famoso y un diplomático competente.

definition: (anatomy) The joint between the upper arm and the forearm.

alternatives.definition: A hit, strike, or blow with the elbow.

example.en: The water's leaking from the elbow of the pipe.
example.es: El agua goteaba por el codo de la cañería.

definition: (geography) Relating to the coast; on or near the coast; longshore.

example.en: Coastal cities will take the brunt of the storm.
example.es: Las ciudades costeras sufrirán lo peor de la tormenta.

definition: (watercraft) A boat or ship used to transport people, smaller vehicles and goods from one port to another, usually on a regular schedule.

example.en: There were not more than one hundred passengers on board the ferry.
example.es: No éramos más de cien pasajeros a bordo del ferry.

definition: In a private manner.

example.en: I want to talk privately with Tom.
example.es: Quiero hablar con Tom en privado.

definition: In a state between dry and wet; moderately wet; moist.

alternatives.definition: Moisture; humidity; dampness.
To suppress vibrations (mechanical) or oscillations (electrical) by converting energy to heat (or some other form of energy).

example.en: After it rains and the ground is damp, it's easier to pull weeds.
example.es: Después de llover y estando el suelo húmedo, es más sencillo quitar la maleza.

definition: Completely or to the greatest degree.

example.en: It is utterly impossible to finish the work within a month.
example.es: Es completamente imposible terminar el trabajo en un mes.

definition: The words of a song, usually used in the plural lyrics.

example.en: What's your favorite song lyric?
example.es: ¿Cuál es tu letra de una canción favorita?

definition: A sudden shaking of the ground caused by movement within the Earth.

example.en: There will be a big earthquake in the future.
example.es: En el futuro habrá un gran terremoto.

definition: (phonetics) Consisting of, or characterized by, voice, or tone produced in the larynx, which may be modified, either by resonance, as in the case of the vowels, or by obstructive action, as in certain consonants, such as v, l, etc., or by both, as in the nasals m, n, ng.

example.en: Do fish have vocal cords?
example.es: ¿Los peces tienen cuerdas vocales?

definition: The state of being hostile.

example.en: Hostilities temporarily ceased.
example.es: Las hostilidades han cesado temporalmente.

definition: Unable (or partially able) to hear.

example.en: He is deaf, but knows how to read lips.
example.es: Él es sordo, pero sabe leer los movimientos de los labios.

definition: Anything that protects or defends; defense; shelter; protection.

alternatives.definition: (ambitransitive) To protect, to defend.

example.en: I used his beheaded body as a shield.
example.es: Usé su cuerpo decapitado como escudo.

definition: Good and important enough to spend time, effort, or money on.
meaning: de valor; que compensa el esfuerzo; que merece la pena

example.en: All in all, nothing worthwhile comes without a fight.
example.es: Al fin y al cabo, nada que valga la pena se consigue sin luchar.

definition: An actual instance when a situation occurs; an event or happening.

example.en: We will study the underlying molecular occurrences of fertilization.
example.es: Estudiaremos los eventos celulares y moleculares subyacentes en la fecundación.

definition: Extremely good or impressive.

example.en: The scenery is really splendid.
example.es: El paisaje es realmente espléndido.

definition: The moment of becoming aware of something; also spelled realisation.

example.en: The conception for the project stems from Mrs. Rodríguez, but the majority of its realization was through the efforts of Mrs. Hurtado and Mrs. Romero.
example.es: La concepción del proyecto se debe a la señora Rodríguez pero el grueso de su realización de lo debemos a las señoras Hurtado y Romero.

definition: A small, open, wheeled vehicle, drawn or pushed by a person or animal, often with two wheels on one axle, more often used for transporting goods than passengers.

example.en: That would be putting the cart before the horse.
example.es: Eso sería poner el carro delante de los caballos.

definition: To call people together; to convene; to convoke.

alternatives.definition: (fantasy, transitive) To call a resource by magic.

example.en: I think you know why I summoned you.
example.es: Pienso que usted sabe por qué le he hecho venir.

definition: The state of being accountable; liability to be called on to render an account or give an explanation; liability to be held responsible or answerable for something.

alternatives.definition: (military) The obligation imposed by law or regulation on an officer or other person for keeping an accurate record of property, documents, or funds.

example.en: There was no accountability.
example.es: No hubo responsables del hecho.

definition: To use a compiler to process source code and produce executable code.

example.en: I'm having some problems compiling this software.
example.es: Tengo problemas para compilar este programa.

definition: (music) A large group of musicians who play together on various instruments, usually including some from strings, woodwind, brass and/or percussion; the instruments played by such a group.

example.en: I play trumpet in a symphonic wind orchestra.
example.es: Yo toco trompeta en una orquesta sinfónica de vientos.

definition: A metamorphic rock of crystalline limestone.

alternatives.definition: A small ball used in games, originally of marble but now usually of glass or ceramic.
To get or have the streaked or swirled appearance of certain types of marble, for example due to the incomplete mixing of viscous ingredients, or the uneven application of paint or other colorants.

example.en: The sink is made of marble.
example.es: La pila es de mármol.

definition: (disease) Diabetes mellitus; any of a group of metabolic diseases whereby a person (or other animal) has high blood sugar due to an inability to produce, or inability to metabolize, sufficient quantities of the hormone insulin.

example.en: Have you ever been diagnosed with diabetes?
example.es: ¿Te han diagnosticado alguna vez de diabetes?

definition: (physics) Of a body in motion: the tendency of a body to maintain its inertial motion; the product of its mass and velocity, or the vector sum of the products of its masses and velocities.

example.en: Newton's Second Law says: "Force is equal to the change in momentum per change in time. For a constant mass, force equals mass times acceleration".
example.es: La Segunda Ley de Newton enuncia: "La fuerza es igual a el cambio en el impulso por el cambio en el tiempo. Para una masa constante, la fuerza equivale a la masa por la aceleración."

definition: To divert the attention of.

example.en: Tom tried to distract the police so Mary could escape.
example.es: Tom intentó distraer a la policía para que Mary pudiese escapar.

definition: A formal written request made by an individual or a group of people to a sovereign or political authority, often containing many signatures, soliciting some grace, right, mercy, or the redress of some wrong or grievance.

alternatives.definition: To make a petition to (a sovereign or political authority).

example.en: More than 10,000 people signed the petition.
example.es: Más de diez mil personas firmaron la petición.

definition: To the furthest or most extreme extent; absolute, complete, total, unconditional.

alternatives.definition: Sometimes preceded by forth, out, etc.: to produce (a cry, speech, or other sounds) with the voice.

example.en: He was an utter stranger.
example.es: Él era un completo extraño.

definition: Of sound, a voice or an instrument, low in pitch or frequency.

example.en: Tom plays the bass guitar in our band.
example.es: Tom toca el bajo en nuestra banda.

definition: Perfunctory or merely symbolic; done or existing for appearance's sake, or to minimally comply with a requirement.

alternatives.definition: Something serving as an expression of something else.
A piece of stamped metal or plastic, etc., used as a form of currency; a voucher that can be exchanged for goods or services.

example.en: Here is a present for you in token of our appreciation.
example.es: Este es un presente como muestra de nuestro agradecimiento.

definition: A cloth used for wiping, especially one used for drying anything wet, such as a person after a bath.

example.en: I dried myself with the towel Tom handed me.
example.es: Me sequé con la toalla que me pasó Tom.

definition: Without a companion or instructor.

alternatives.definition: A job or performance done by one person alone.
(games) A card game similar to whist in which each player plays against the others in turn without a partner

example.en: I plan to play a flute solo.
example.es: Pienso tocar un solo de flauta.

definition: Not pleasant.

example.en: He has an unpleasant look in his eyes.
example.es: Él tiene una mirada desagradable.

definition: A long step in walking.

alternatives.definition: To walk with long steps.

example.en: Doctors have made great strides in their fight against cancer.
example.es: Los médicos han hecho grandes avances en su lucha contra el cáncer.

definition: A motion like that of waves; a moving in this and that direction; an irregular rising and falling.

example.en: A small fluctuation in temperature is normal.
example.es: Una pequeña fluctuación de temperatura es normal.
example.attribution: Original example · English Learning, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0

definition: a person who runs

example.en: The runner sprinted on the last lap.
example.es: El corredor apretó en la última vuelta.

definition: a male royal person

example.en: The prince was changed into a tree by magic.
example.es: El príncipe fue cambiado en árbol por magia.

definition: To make simpler, either by reducing in complexity, reducing to component parts, or making easier to understand.

example.en: A good writer needs to be able to simplify complicated things.
example.es: Un buen escritor necesita el don de simplificar lo complicado.

definition: (pathology) A recognizable pattern of signs, symptoms and/or behaviours, especially of a disease or medical or psychological condition.

example.en: I suffer from restless leg syndrome.
example.es: Sufro del síndrome de piernas inquietas.

definition: The state of being complicated; intricate or confused relation of parts; complexity.

example.en: Have you ever had any complications during past pregnancies?
example.es: ¿Has tenido alguna vez alguna complicación en anteriores embarazos?

definition: As a matter of supposition; in the beliefs or according to the claims of some people.

example.en: Supposedly it's going to rain soon.
example.es: Supuestamente pronto se pondrá a llover.

definition: (chemistry) Relating to, or consisting of, or produced by molecules.

example.en: According to the popular “nebular hypothesis,” the solar system was formed as the result of the gravitational collapse of a fragment of a giant molecular cloud.
example.es: Según la popular "hipótesis nebular", el sistema solar se formó como resultado del colapso gravitacional de un fragmento de una gigante nube molecular.

definition: A frame, usually portable, of wood, metal, or rope, used for ascent and descent, consisting of two side pieces to which are fastened rungs (cross strips or rounds acting as steps).

alternatives.definition: (figuratively) The hierarchy or ranking system within an organization, such as the corporate ladder.
(chiefly, Britain) A length of unravelled fabric in a knitted garment, especially in nylon stockings; a run.

example.en: He lost his balance and fell off the ladder.
example.es: Él perdió el equilibrio y se cayó de la escalera.

definition: (geography) Sharing a border; geographically adjacent.

alternatives.definition: (uncomparable) Of, relating to, or located at or near a margin or edge; also figurative usages of location and margin (edge).
Of a value, or having a characteristic that is of a value, that is close to being unacceptable or leading to exclusion from a group or category.

example.en: The new process produced only a marginal improvement.
example.es: El nuevo proceso produjo solo una mejora mínima.
example.attribution: Original example · English Learning, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0

definition: A passing of royal powers.

example.en: They won the Japan Cup three years in succession.
example.es: Ellos ganaron la Copa de Japón durante tres años consecutivos.

definition: Of, or pertaining to, philosophy.

example.en: People are too materialistic these days, in the vulgar, rather than the philosophical sense of the word.
example.es: La gente es muy materialista estos días, en el sentido vulgar, más que en el filosófico, de la palabra.

definition: In a beautiful manner.

example.en: She played the piano beautifully.
example.es: Ella tocaba maravillosamente el piano.

definition: One who is not part of a community or organization.

alternatives.definition: A newcomer with little or no experience in an organization or community.

example.en: I feel like an outsider.
example.es: Me siento como un extraño.

definition: A (small) piece; a fragment; a detached, incomplete portion.

alternatives.definition: Discarded objects (especially metal) that may be dismantled to recover their constituent materials, junk.
To discard; to get rid of.

example.en: Please get me a scrap of paper.
example.es: Por favor, consígueme un trocito de papel.

definition: The meat of the aforementioned animal.

example.en: Let me show you how to milk a goat.
example.es: Déjame mostrarte cómo ordeñar una cabra.

definition: A written law or ordinance passed by a legislative body.

example.en: He got off because of the statute of limitations.
example.es: Al estar prescrito el delito no lo condenaron.

definition: Anything that acts as counterbalance; a compensating equivalent.

alternatives.definition: (programming) The difference between a target memory address and a base address.
The distance by which one thing is out of alignment with another.

example.en: Lower fuel costs helped offset the higher rent.
example.es: Los menores costos de combustible ayudaron a compensar el alquiler más alto.
example.attribution: Original example · English Learning, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0

definition: A person or thing that translates meaning from one language into another, particularly

example.en: I am studying to be a translator or interpreter.
example.es: Me estoy preparando para ser traductor o intérprete.

definition: A fee paid for some liberty or privilege, particularly for the privilege of passing over a bridge or on a highway, or for that of vending goods in a fair, market, etc.

alternatives.definition: (figuratively) To make a sound as if made by a bell.

example.en: Do we need to take a toll road? We're not in a hurry.
example.es: ¿Tenemos que coger una autopista de peaje? No tenemos ninguna prisa.

definition: Completely or entirely.

example.en: It's a wholly new experience for me.
example.es: Es una experiencia totalmente nueva para mí.

definition: A wandering on foot; an idle and leisurely walk; a ramble; a saunter.

alternatives.definition: To wander on foot; to ramble idly or leisurely; to rove.

example.en: A short stroll along the beach gave me a good appetite for breakfast.
example.es: Un pequeño paseo por la playa me causó un gran apetito para desayunar.

definition: A lifting of the shoulders to signal indifference or a casual lack of knowledge.

alternatives.definition: (ambitransitive) To raise (the shoulders) to express uncertainty, lack of concern, (formerly) dread, etc.
alternatives.meaning: encogerse de hombros; encoger / alzar los hombros

example.en: Shrug your shoulders.
example.es: Encógete de hombros.

definition: On board; into or within a ship or boat; hence, into or within a railway car.

alternatives.definition: On board of; onto or into a ship, boat, train, plane.

example.en: How many sailors were aboard the ship that sunk?
example.es: ¿Cuántos marineros iban a bordo del barco que se hundió?

definition: A place for discussion.

example.en: I contribute to this forum almost every day.
example.es: Contribuyo a este foro casi todos los días.

definition: (politics, economic liberalism) A socio-economic system based on private property rights, including the private ownership of resources or capital, with economic decisions made largely through the operation of a market unregulated by the state.

example.en: In capitalism, a citizen is not obligated to shop.
example.es: En el capitalismo, un ciudadano no está obligado a comprar.

definition: Arranged neatly and in order.

alternatives.definition: To make tidy; to neaten.

example.en: Tom is tidy.
example.es: Tom es ordenado.

definition: An informal word for automobile.

example.en: Lawyers and auto mechanics are the people I trust the least.
example.es: Los abogados y los mecánicos son las personas en que menos confío.

definition: Causing death; lethal.

example.en: Envy is one of the seven deadly sins.
example.es: La envidia es uno de los siete pecados capitales.

definition: Interacting with or communicating with and reacting to each other; influencing or having an effect on each other; acting or capable of acting on each other or with the other.

example.en: The museum has an interactive map for visitors.
example.es: El museo tiene un mapa interactivo para los visitantes.
example.attribution: Original example · English Learning, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0

definition: The ability to endure pain or hardship; endurance.

example.en: Tolerance becomes a crime when applied to evil.
example.es: La tolerancia se convierte en crimen cuando se aplica al mal.

definition: A place in which a person lives.

example.en: The habitat of seals is typically coastal areas.
example.es: El hábitat de las focas suelen ser las zonas de costa.

definition: Providing support.

example.en: Be supportive.
example.es: Apóyame.

definition: The feel or shape of a surface or substance; the smoothness, roughness, softness, etc. of something.

example.en: This material has a rough texture.
example.es: Este material tiene una textura rugosa.

definition: the buying and selling of goods

example.en: I'd like to understand how commerce works.
example.es: Me gustaría entender como el comercio funciona.

definition: To raise (something) to a higher position.

example.en: Improved conditions elevate the human experience.
example.es: Condiciones mejoradas elevan la experiencia humana.

definition: a person who works on a ship

alternatives.definition: A person who sails sailing boats (as opposed to boats powered by other means) as a sport or recreation.

example.en: Tom acted the part of a sailor.
example.es: Tom hizo el papel de un marinero.

definition: To grow plants, notably crops.

example.en: We cultivate rice.
example.es: Cultivamos arroz.

definition: A specific degree of pulverization of coffee beans.

alternatives.definition: A tedious and laborious task.
To reduce to smaller pieces by crushing with lateral motion.

example.en: I grind my own coffee beans every morning.
example.es: Muelo mis propios granos de café todas las mañanas.

definition: done on purpose

alternatives.definition: Formed with deliberation; carefully considered; not sudden or rash.
To consider carefully; to weigh well in the mind.

example.en: She was deliberate in everything she did.
example.es: Ella fue deliberada en todo lo que hizo.

definition: Able to live on its own (as for a newborn).

example.en: I think it's viable.
example.es: Creo que es viable.

definition: A metal fastener consisting of a cylindrical body that is threaded, with a larger head on one end. It can be inserted into an unthreaded hole up to the head, with a nut then threaded on the other end; a heavy machine screw.

alternatives.definition: A sliding pin or bar in a lock or latch mechanism.
A bar of wood or metal dropped in horizontal hooks on a door and adjoining wall or between the two sides of a double door, to prevent the door(s) from being forced open.

example.en: This bolt fits this nut.
example.es: Este tornillo encaja con esta tuerca.

definition: Of or pertaining to a mother; having the characteristics of a mother; motherly.

example.en: My maternal grandfather was a murderer.
example.es: Mi abuelo materno fue un asesino.

definition: Having the form of a line; straight or roughly straight; following a direct course.

alternatives.definition: (physics) A type of length measurement involving only one spatial dimension (as opposed to area or volume).

example.en: He's an eccentric man who thought that time was not linear.
example.es: Es un hombre excéntrico que pensaba que el tiempo no era lineal.

definition: To remove a cover from.

example.en: Sometimes you just need to check the library archives to uncover the hypocrisy of some people.
example.es: A veces solo hay que tirar de hemeroteca para destapar la hipocresía de algunas personas.

definition: Half of the way between two points
meaning: a caballo entre; a mediados; a mitad de

example.en: Let's meet halfway between your house and mine.
example.es: Encontrémonos a mitad de camino entre tu casa y la mía.

definition: One who conducts the business of banking; one who, individually, or as a member of a company, keeps an establishment for the deposit or loan of money, or for traffic in money, bills of exchange, etc.

example.en: Tom has an uncle who is a banker.
example.es: Tom tiene un tío que es banquero.

definition: (sometimes, proscribed) In a continuous manner; non-stop.

example.en: If the universe is full of stars, why doesn't their light continually light up the entire sky?
example.es: Si el universo está lleno de estrellas, ¿por qué la luz que proviene de todas ellas no hace que brille continuamente el cielo entero?

definition: Strangely unconventional; highly unusual and different from common experience, often in an extravagant, fantastic, and/or conspicuous way.

example.en: This is so bizarre.
example.es: Esto es tan extraño.

definition: (chemistry, physics) The smallest possible amount of matter which still retains its identity as a chemical element, now known to consist of a nucleus surrounded by electrons.

example.en: A water molecule has two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
example.es: Una molécula de agua tiene dos átomos de hidrógeno y un átomo de oxígeno.

definition: The property or state of being relevant or pertinent.

example.en: Explain the relevance of this example to your argument.
example.es: Explica la relevancia de este ejemplo para tu argumento.
example.attribution: Original example · English Learning, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0

definition: Of, relating to, supporting, or advocating socialism.

example.en: The Socialist Party only got 18% of the votes.
example.es: El Partido Socialista sólo consiguió el 18% de los votos.

definition: To undo a folding.

alternatives.definition: To turn out; to happen; to develop.

example.en: As the plot unfolds, the mystery becomes clearer.
example.es: Mientras la trama se desenvuelve, el misterio se vuelve claro.

definition: Prejudice or discrimination based upon race or ethnicity; an action of such discrimination.

example.en: Black Americans continued to suffer from racism.
example.es: Los negros estadounidenses siguen siendo víctimas del racismo.

definition: A rush or hurry, especially making use of the limbs against a surface.

alternatives.definition: To move hurriedly to a location, especially by using all limbs against a surface.
To quickly deploy (vehicles, usually aircraft) to a destination in response to an alert, usually to intercept an attacking enemy.

example.en: There was a scramble to collect the fallen papers.
example.es: Hubo una carrera apresurada para recoger los papeles caídos.
example.attribution: Original example · English Learning, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0

definition: A thrust; a push; a sudden force that impels.

alternatives.definition: A wish or urge, particularly a sudden one prompting action.

example.en: It was hard to resist the impulse to wring Tom's neck.
example.es: Era difícil resistir el impulso de retorcerle el cuello a Tom.

definition: According to reports or rumors.

example.en: This gun is reportedly very powerful.
example.es: Según consta, esta arma es muy poderosa.

definition: The resentful, indignant, or shocked anger aroused by such acts.

alternatives.definition: To cause or commit an outrage upon; to treat with violence or abuse.

example.en: What that man's done is an outrage.
example.es: Lo que ha hecho ese hombre es una atrocidad.

definition: Often used when someone does not understand what another person says.

example.en: I beg your pardon. I didn't quite catch your name.
example.es: Disculpa, no escuché, ¿cómo te llamas?

definition: Made of straw.

alternatives.definition: A dried stalk of a cereal plant.
(uncommon) A pale, yellowish beige colour, like that of a dried straw.

example.en: It is the last straw that breaks the camel's back.
example.es: Es la gota que colma el vaso.

definition: An addition or annex to a group, set, or total.

example.en: We want accessibility and inclusion for everyone.
example.es: Queremos accesibilidad e inclusión para todos.

definition: Utter; complete; absolute.

example.en: The CIA runs a thorough background check on all new employees.
example.es: La CIA realiza un exhaustivo control de antecedentes para todos los nuevos empleados.

definition: The state of being a citizen; the status of a citizen.

example.en: I want my children to have dual citizenship.
example.es: Quiero que mis hijos tengan doble ciudadanía.

definition: (toxicology, pharmaceutical drug) Having a chemical nature that is harmful to health or lethal if consumed or otherwise entering into the body in sufficient quantities.

example.en: Chocolate is toxic to dogs and it can kill them!
example.es: ¡El chocolate es tóxico para los perros y puede matarlos!

definition: A small pack or package; a little bundle or parcel

example.en: Another packet of sugar, please.
example.es: Por favor, otro sobre de azúcar.

definition: To get back; to recover possession of.

example.en: Tom never did regain his memory after the accident.
example.es: Tom nunca recuperó su memoria después del accidente.

definition: A shop or store that sells groceries; a grocery store.

example.en: Where is the grocery store?
example.es: ¿Dondé esta la tienda de ultramarinos?

definition: A thing that has been reconstructed or restored to an earlier state.

example.en: The museum displays a reconstruction of the old bridge.
example.es: El museo exhibe una reconstrucción del antiguo puente.
example.attribution: Original example · English Learning, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0

definition: A cabinet, closet, or other piece of furniture with shelves intended for storing cookware, dishware, or food; similar cabinets or closets used for storing other items.

example.en: She stacked the trays in the cupboard.
example.es: Ella apiló las bandejas en el armario.

definition: (originally, sciences) The study of methods used in a field.

example.en: The researchers explained their methodology in the report.
example.es: Los investigadores explicaron su metodología en el informe.
example.attribution: Original example · English Learning, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0

definition: A surprising and previously unknown fact that is made known.

alternatives.definition: (biblical) The final book of the New Testament of the Bible.

example.en: The highest revelation is that God is in every man.
example.es: La revelación más alta es que Dios está en cada hombre.

definition: The study of the physical properties of the earth, including how humans affect and are affected by them.

The modern (US) engineer's or surveyor's rod commonly is eight or ten feet long and often designed to extend higher. In former times a surveyor's rod often was a single wooden pole or composed of multiple sectioned and socketed pieces, and besides serving as a sighting target was used to measure distance on the ground horizontally, hence for convenience was of one rod or pole in length, that is, 5+1⁄2 yards.

An awkward situation of some kind (especially money or social) which is difficult to escape.

example.en: The young woman slapped the man who pinched her buttocks.
example.es: La joven le dio un cachetazo al hombre que le pellizcó el trasero.

definition: Toward a lower level, whether in physical space, in a hierarchy, or in amount or value.

example.en: The path slopes downward toward the lake.
example.es: El sendero desciende hacia el lago.
example.attribution: Original example · English Learning, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0

definition: A familiar, invented name for a person or thing used instead of the actual name of the person or thing, often based on some noteworthy characteristic.

alternatives.definition: To give a nickname to (a person or thing).

example.en: I didn't know Tom had a nickname.
example.es: No sabía que Tom tenía un sobrenombre.

definition: Not aware or informed; lacking knowledge; unmindful.

example.en: Tom is unaware of what has happened.
example.es: Tom ignora lo que ha ocurrido.

definition: To express one’s sympathetic pleasure or joy to the person(s) it is felt for; to felicitate.

example.en: We want to congratulate them on their good work.
example.es: Queremos felicitarles por su buen trabajo.

definition: An unpowered wheeled vehicle (not a caravan or camper) that is towed behind another, and used to carry equipment, etc., that cannot be carried in the leading vehicle.

alternatives.definition: A short blank segment of film at the end of a reel, for convenient insertion of the film in a projector.

example.en: I thought you were used to living in a trailer.
example.es: Pensé que estabas acostumbrado a vivir en un remolque.

definition: A bump left on the skin after having been stung.

alternatives.definition: A sharp, localized pain primarily on the epidermis.
(law enforcement) A police operation in which the police pretend to engage in criminal activity in order to catch a criminal.

example.en: I got a nasty sting from a wasp.
example.es: Me llevé una fuerte picadura de una avispa.

definition: A system of government-imposed duties levied on imported or exported goods; a list of such duties, or the duties themselves.

alternatives.definition: To levy a duty on (something).

example.en: Tariffs only makes products made in other countries become more expensive.
example.es: Los aranceles sólo hacen que los productos hechos en otros países se vuelvan más caros.

definition: (British) To cover something with paving slabs.

example.en: The digital revolution is paving the way towards strikingly new forms of social relationships.
example.es: La revolución digital pavimenta el camino hacia sorprendentes nuevas formas de relaciones sociales.

definition: Of objects, the property of being coincident; occurring at the same time or place.

example.en: I wonder if it really was a coincidence.
example.es: Me pregunto si verdaderamente fue una coincidencia.

definition: Most important or prominent.

example.en: Mary is the country's foremost expert on the conflict in Syria.
example.es: Mary es la mayor experta del país en el conflicto en Siria.

definition: A state of discomfort arising from bashfulness or consciousness of having violated a social rule; humiliation.

example.es: ¡Qué bochorno!

definition: (chiefly, uncountable) The act of turning around a centre or an axis.

example.en: It's possible to calculate the Earth's mass using a formula that includes the Moon's rotation period around the sun, the average distance between the Earth and the Moon, the gravitational context and the number π.
example.es: Es posible calcular la masa de la Tierra usando una fórmula que incluye el periodo de rotación de la Luna alrededor de la Tierra, la distancia media entre la Tierra y la Luna, la constante de gravitación universal y el número π.

definition: a yellow citrus fruit

alternatives.definition: Of the pale yellow colour/color of lemons.

example.es: Me comí un limón fresco por la vitamina C.

definition: a tendency to expect the best, or at least, a favourable outcome

example.en: There is considerable optimism that the economy will improve.
example.es: Hay un considerable optimismo de que la economía mejorará.

definition: Freight carried by a ship, aircraft, or motor vehicle.

example.en: A cargo vessel, bound for Athens, sank in the Mediterranean without a trace.
example.es: Un buque de carga, con rumbo a Atenas, se hundió en el Mediterráneo sin dejar rastro.

definition: Not awake; having no awareness .

alternatives.definition: (psychology) Without directed thought or awareness.
(psychology) That part of mind that is not consciously perceived.

example.en: I can't tell if Tom is dead or just unconscious.
example.es: No puedo decir si Tom está muerto o solo inconsciente.

definition: Of, or relating to, psychiatry.

example.en: Have you ever been hospitalized in a psychiatric hospital?
example.es: ¿Te han hospitalizado alguna vez en un hospital psiquiátrico?

definition: The act of grazing; a scratching or injuring lightly on passing.

alternatives.definition: To feed or supply (cattle, sheep, etc.) with grass; to furnish pasture for.
(ambitransitive) To feed on; to eat (growing herbage); to eat grass from (a pasture)

example.en: The sheep graze the grass in the field.
example.es: Las ovejas pastan en el campo.

definition: Placed in a lower class, rank, or position.

alternatives.definition: To treat (someone) as of less value or importance.

example.en: Can you describe the ideal supervisor-subordinate relationship?
example.es: ¿Puedes describir la relación supervisor - subordinado ideal?

definition: (chiefly, North American) Useless physical things to be discarded; rubbish; refuse.

alternatives.definition: (chiefly, North American, metonym) A container into which things are discarded.
(computing) Temporary storage on disk for files that the user has deleted, allowing them to be recovered if necessary.

example.en: I should probably just toss this in the trash.
example.es: Probablemente debería tirar esto a la basura.

definition: A little spark; a scintillation.

alternatives.definition: Brilliance; luster.
(by extension) To shine as if throwing off sparks; to emit flashes of light; to scintillate; to twinkle

example.en: The dew on the trees sparkles in the morning sun.
example.es: El sol matinal hace brillar la escarcha sobre las ramas.

definition: Having the power or quality of deciding a question or controversy; putting an end to contest or controversy; final; conclusive.

alternatives.definition: Marked by promptness and decision.

example.en: You're decisive.
example.es: Eres decidido.

definition: Absence of responsibility for a crime, tort, etc.

example.en: I tried to convince him of my innocence.
example.es: Traté de convencerlo de mi inocencia.

definition: A period of unusually low rainfall, longer and more severe than a dry spell.

example.en: The drought did severe damage to the harvest.
example.es: La sequía perjudicó gravemente a la cosecha.

definition: The abdomen (especially a fat one).

example.en: A man with a full belly thinks no one is hungry.
example.es: Un hombre con la barriga llena piensa que nadie está hambriento.

definition: A board game for two players, each beginning with sixteen chess pieces moving according to fixed rules across a chessboard with the objective to checkmate the opposing king.

example.en: He would like to know whether you play chess.
example.es: Él quisiera saber si juegas al ajedrez.

definition: Soon; also used, especially in American English, to mean currently.

example.en: Presently, Russia has a few more nuclear warheads than the United States.
example.es: Actualmente Rusia tiene algunas ojivas nucleares más que Estados Unidos.

definition: A cord that, when lit, conveys the fire to some explosive device, such as a bomb.

alternatives.definition: (electrical engineering) A device to prevent excessive overcurrent from overload or short circuit in an electrical circuit, containing a component that melts and interrupts the current when too high a load is passed through it.
(manufacturing, mining, military) The mechanism that ignites the charge in an explosive device; a detonator.

example.en: It was necessary to set the fuse.
example.es: Había que graduar la espoleta.

definition: Not bright or colorful.

alternatives.definition: (colloquial) Not smart or intelligent.
To make something less bright.

example.en: Tom wasn't able to read in the dim light.
example.es: Tom no fue capaz de leer bajo la tenue luz.

definition: Lack of artificial ornament, pretentious style, or luxury; plainness

alternatives.definition: The quality or state of being not complex, or of consisting of few parts.

example.en: I like the simplicity of her dress.
example.es: Me gusta la sencillez del vestido de ella.

definition: The ability to read and write.

alternatives.definition: (by extension) The ability to understand and evaluate something.

example.en: This organisation promotes literacy in rural areas.
example.es: Esta organización promociona el alfabetismo en áreas rurales.

definition: The intercardinal compass point halfway between west and north; specifically at a bearing of 315°.

example.en: The mountains lie to the northwest of the city.
example.es: Las montañas se encuentran al noroeste de la ciudad.
example.attribution: Original example · English Learning, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0

definition: The act or an instance of repeating or being repeated.

example.en: Repetition helps you remember something.
example.es: La repetición te ayuda a recordar las cosas.

definition: The state of being kind.

example.en: Her kindness gave me a lump in my throat.
example.es: Su bondad hizo que se me pusiera un nudo en la garganta.

definition: The ability to move; capacity for movement.

example.en: A bishop that is trapped by its own pawns and so has little mobility is called a bad-squared bishop.
example.es: Un alfil que está bloqueado por sus propios peones y, por lo tanto, tiene poca movilidad se llama alfil malo.

definition: Contrary to reason or propriety; obviously and flatly opposed to manifest truth; inconsistent with the plain dictates of common sense; logically contradictory; nonsensical; ridiculous; silly.

example.en: You cannot achieve the impossible without attempting the absurd.
example.es: No puedes conseguir lo imposible sin intentar lo absurdo.

definition: The act of reproducing new individuals biologically.

example.en: We're studying human reproduction.
example.es: Estamos estudiando la reproducción humana.

definition: Access to a resource for a period of time, generally for payment.

example.en: How much does a newspaper subscription cost?
example.es: ¿Cuánto cuesta una suscripción a un periódico?

definition: Coming one after the other in a series.

example.en: It rained five successive days.
example.es: Estuvo lloviendo cinco días seguidos.

definition: (ambitransitive) To restore a friendly relationship; to bring back or return to harmony.

example.en: My mother tried to reconcile the couple.
example.es: Mi madre trató de reconciliar a la pareja.

definition: In a tidy and orderly way.

example.en: She is always neatly dressed.
example.es: Ella siempre está vestida impecable.

definition: A measure; a standard of measure; an instrument to determine dimensions, distance, or capacity; a standard

alternatives.definition: Any instrument for ascertaining or regulating the level, state, dimensions or forms of things
To measure or determine with a gauge; to measure the capacity of.

example.en: Is there an air gauge here?
example.es: ¿Hay un manómetro de aire aquí?

definition: (religion) A person who travels attempting to spread a religion or creed (Particularly used in context of Christianity).

example.en: Tom went to Korea as a Christian missionary.
example.es: Tom fue a Corea como misionero cristiano.

definition: (also, figurative) Something that tempts or attracts, especially one with a promise of reward or pleasure.

example.es: Él sintió el aliciente de la aventura.

example.es: El arcoíris forma un arco en el cielo.

example.en: I have a bruise on my left leg.
example.es: Tengo un moretón en la pierna izquierda.

definition: Likely or most likely to be true.

example.es: Es posible pero no probable.

definition: Of, or involving more than two nations (externally between countries or internally in a country).

example.es: De joven Mary aseguraba que el dinero era la raíz de todos los males humanos; no obstante lo cual, a los cuarenta y pocos, acabó siendo ejecutiva jefe de una multinacional.

definition: A fungus producing such fruiting bodies.

example.en: It's a mushroom.
example.es: Es una seta.

example.es: Las flores se mecían en el viento.

example.es: La velocidad media del viento es muy baja.

example.es: De repente apareció un hombre en la puerta.

example.en: She is more of an acquaintance than a friend.
example.es: Ella más que una amiga es una conocida.

example.en: An ant can lift more than 50 times its weight.
example.es: Una hormiga puede levantar más de 50 veces su propio peso.

definition: Demonstrating thought or careful consideration.

alternatives.definition: Demonstrating kindness or consideration for others.

example.en: She had a thoughtful look on her face.
example.es: Ella tenía una cara pensativa.

definition: A control on a carburetor to adjust the air/fuel mixture when the engine is cold.

alternatives.definition: (sports) In wrestling, karate (etc.), a type of hold that can result in strangulation.

example.es: Ten cuidado de no atragantarte con las uvas.

definition: Best or most suitable under the circumstances.

example.es: Encontrar una solución óptima demorará un tiempo.

definition: The open admittance of having done something (especially something bad).

example.es: La ley no permite la confesión bajo tortura.

definition: A standard by which something is evaluated or measured.
meaning: acotación referencial; cota de referencia; estándar de comparación

example.es: Este resultado proporciona un punto de referencia para futuros estudios.
example.attribution: Original example · English Learning, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0

example.en: May I escort you home?
example.es: ¿La acompaño a su casa?

definition: A form of unglazed earthenware.

example.es: Compartió su caja de galletas con todos sus amigos.

definition: the science of matter and energy

example.es: Como de costumbre, el profesor de física llegó tarde a clase.

definition: Not limp; firm, stiff; not stale or wilted; fresh; also, effervescent, lively.

alternatives.definition: Of action, movement, a person's manner, etc.: precise and quick; brisk.

example.en: I like the crisp taste of menthol cigarettes.
example.es: Me gusta el sabor fresco de los cigarros mentolados.

example.es: La envidia es uno de los siete pecados capitales.

alternatives.definition: To include within its scope; to circumscribe or go round so as to surround; to enclose; to contain.

example.es: La inteligencia artificial es un amplio campo que abarca numerosas técnicas y aplicaciones.

example.es: La ciudad fue arruinada por el brutal poder de la naturaleza.

example.es: Nos dimos por más que satisfechos cuando el Gobierno rumano, incluso antes de pertenecer a la Unión Europea, mostró su voluntad de aceptar esta directiva.

example.es: El boy scout obtuvo una insignia honorífica.

example.attribution: Original example · English Learning, 2026 · CC BY-SA 4.0

definition: A single item of clothing.

example.es: Me pregunto de qué tejidos estará hecha esta prenda.

alternatives.definition: The buttocks.

example.es: El dominio de la empresa sobre el mercado está disminuyendo.

definition: A system of tracks and trains; especially American English.

example.es: El coste de construir el ferrocarril era demasiado alto.

alternatives.definition: To equip and fit (a ship) with sails, shrouds, and yards.

example.es: Tom trabaja en una plataforma petrolífera.

definition: An act in the past which may be used as an example to help decide the outcome of similar instances in the future.

example.es: Sentó un precedente.

definition: Capable of being understood; comprehensible.

example.es: Su rabia es comprensible.

example.es: Toda persona tiene derecho, en condiciones de plena igualdad, a ser oída públicamente y con justicia por un tribunal independiente e imparcial, para la determinación de sus derechos y obligaciones o para el examen de cualquier acusación contra ella en materia penal.

definition: A positive emotion including wonder and approbation; the regarding of another as being wonderful

example.es: No quiero admiración, sólo reconocimiento.

example.es: La adicción a las drogas es un cáncer en la sociedad moderna.

alternatives.definition: Something acting as a cushion, especially to absorb a shock or impact.

example.es: El gatito ha desgarrado un cojín y ha esparcido el relleno por todo el comedor y el pasillo.

example.es: Tom no puede distinguir a un caballo de un poni.

example.es: Considero la conciencia fundamental. Considero la materia como derivado de la conciencia. No podemos dejar de lado la conciencia. Todo lo que hablamos, todo lo que consideramos existente presupone la conciencia.

example.es: Apenas había terminado de hablar cuando él la interrumpió.

example.en: Fortunately, the shark bite didn't hit any major arteries.
example.es: Afortunadamente, la mordedura de tiburón no dañó ninguna arteria principal.

definition: Any animal or other organism that hunts and kills other non-plant organisms (their prey), primarily for food.

example.es: El lobo es un depredador.

alternatives.definition: (zoology, agriculture) A male sheep, typically uncastrated.

alternatives.definition: (business, economics) A restriction on the import of something to a specific quantity.

example.es: Fracasé en alcanzar mi cuota hoy.

example.es: Nadie podía reproducir los resultados de ese estudio.

definition: a nations warships

alternatives.definition: Having the dark blue colour of navy blue.
A country's entire maritime military force, including ships and personnel.

example.en: He joined the United States Navy.
example.es: Él se enroló en la armada de los Estados Unidos.

definition: In a way relating to the whole nation.

example.en: The college is accredited nationally.
example.es: La universidad está acreditada a nivel nacional.

definition: The highest rank of noncommissioned officer in some non-naval military forces and police.

example.en: A captain is above a sergeant.
example.es: Un capitán está por sobre un sargento.

definition: The act of renewing.

example.es: La renovación de tu membresía corresponde al próximo mes.

definition: A biography; a book describing the experiences of a subject from personal knowledge of the subject or from sources with personal knowledge of the subject.

example.en: My friends pushed me to write a memoir.
example.es: Mis amigos me obligaron a escribir mis memorias.

definition: (military) A battlefield formation composed of two or more divisions.

example.es: Pertenece al cuerpo diplomático.

example.en: The nectar of the flower and the herb cause allergy to Aksil.
example.es: El néctar de la flor y la hierba provocan alergia a Aksil.

definition: The condition, or the degree, of being fertile.

example.en: Mother Earth represents fertility, motherhood and creation. She is the great sacred womb from which we came and to which we will return after our present existence.
example.es: La Madre Tierra representa la fertilidad, la maternidad y la creación. Es el gran vientre sagrado del que venimos y al que volveremos después de nuestra existencia actual.

definition: An assessment of the quality, performance or value of something.

example.en: The property appraisal took less than an hour.
example.es: La tasación de la propiedad duró menos de una hora.

definition: In a lucky manner; by good fortune; fortunately.

example.en: The anticipation is always worse than the calamity.
example.es: La anticipación siempre es peor que la calamidad.

alternatives.definition: A record of money owed.

example.es: Dejé mi trabajo y me mudé para poder empezar de cero.

definition: Strange, not familiar.

example.en: I am unfamiliar with the customs of this country.
example.es: No estoy familiarizado con las costumbres de este país.

definition: A source of nourishment, such as food, that can be metabolized by an organism to give energy and build tissue.

example.en: Nutrients are absorbed through the wall of the ileum.
example.es: Los nutrientes son absorbidos por la pared del íleon.

definition: (fencing) A cut that lands with the point, often involving a whip of the foible of the blade to strike at a concealed target.

alternatives.definition: To move or hit (something) with a short, quick motion.

example.en: Mary flicked her long ponytail over her shoulder.
example.es: Mary se echó la larga coleta sobre el hombro.

definition: (manner) In an ironic manner; in a way displaying irony.

example.en: Ironically, that old grammar rule that says "never end a sentence with a preposition" does just that!
example.es: ¡Irónicamente, esa vieja regla gramatical que dice "nunca terminar una oración con una preposición" hace precisamente eso!

definition: (post) A rectangular piece of thick paper or thin cardboard, typically used for sending messages by mail without the need for an envelope.

example.en: She sent him a postcard from Boston.
example.es: Le envió una postal desde Boston.

definition: To lapse and become invalid.

example.en: My driver's license will expire next week.
example.es: Mi licencia de conducir expira la semana que viene.

definition: A carnivorous aquatic mammal in one of several families of the infraorder Cetacea, famed for its intelligence and occasional willingness to approach humans.

alternatives.definition: (nautical) A man-made semi submerged maritime structure, usually installed to provide a fixed structure for temporary mooring, to prevent ships from drifting to shallow water or to serve as base for navigational aids.

example.en: Thousands of people went to the beach to see the dolphin.
example.es: Miles de personas fueron a la playa a ver al delfín.

definition: The long, narrow, central body of a spear, arrow, or javelin.

alternatives.definition: (lacrosse) The long narrow body of a lacrosse stick.
(literary) A beam or ray of light.

example.en: The elevator shaft goes all the way to the basement.
example.es: El hueco del ascensor llega hasta el sótano.

definition: The state or act of contemning; the feeling or attitude of regarding someone or something as inferior, base, or worthless; scorn, disdain.

alternatives.definition: (legal) Open disrespect or willful disobedience of the authority of a court of law or legislative body.

example.en: I feel nothing but contempt for such dishonest behavior.
example.es: No siento nada más que desprecio por semejante conducta deshonesta.

definition: (music) Pertaining to, made by, or prepared for an instrument, especially a musical instrument (rather than the human voice).

example.en: I like instrumental music.
example.es: Me gusta la música instrumental.

definition: To stimulate or induce (feelings); pique.

alternatives.definition: To sexually stimulate.
To wake from sleep or stupor; to rouse.

example.en: How to arouse a woman's desire?
example.es: ¿Cómo provocar el deseo de una mujer?

definition: (by extension) A similarly shaped implement with a replaceable supply of flammable material; specifically, a pole with a lamp at one end.

alternatives.definition: (figurative) To make damaging claims about (someone or something); to ruin the reputation of (someone or something); to disparage, to insult.

example.en: Currently, torch-shaped electric lamps are being manufactured.
example.es: Actualmente se fabrican lámparas eléctricas con forma de antorcha.

definition: An informal, potentially rude word for nonsense or something of poor quality.

example.en: What crap! Your arrogant comments aren't just useless but also boring.
example.es: ¡Qué porquería! Tus comentarios arrogantes además de ser inútiles son aburridos.

definition: Information spread to influence opinions, often selectively or misleadingly.

example.en: Hasbara is another word for Zionist propaganda.
example.es: Hasbara es otra forma de llamar a la propaganda sionista.

definition: An action or act; something that is done.

alternatives.definition: A brave or noteworthy action; a feat or exploit.
(legal) A legal instrument that is executed under seal or before a witness; sometimes required for certain legal activities, such as the transfer of certain kinds of property.

example.en: I always feel good after I do my good deed for the day.
example.es: Siempre me siento bien después de hacer mi buena acción del día.

definition: (chiefly, UK, Ireland, except in compounds) An appliance or utensil for cooking food.

example.en: Tom always uses the rice cooker that he brought back from Japan.
example.es: Tom siempre usa la olla de arroz que trajo de Japón.

definition: Relating to the features or study of places on Earth.

example.en: The geographical south pole is the Earth's southernmost point.
example.es: El polo sur geográfico es el punto más al sur de la Tierra.

definition: The practising of something which is to be performed before an audience, usually to test or improve the interaction between several participating people, or to allow technical adjustments with respect to staging to be done.

example.en: After a ten-minute break, we resumed our rehearsal.
example.es: Después de una pausa de diez minutos, continuamos nuestro ensayo.

definition: To make decisions harmful to (a person or group) based on prejudice.

example.en: Don't discriminate against people based on nationality, gender, or occupation.
example.es: No discrimines a la gente basándote en su nacionalidad, sexo u ocupación.

definition: The act of relaxing or the state of being relaxed; the opposite of stress or tension; the aim of recreation and leisure activities.

example.en: Stupidity is the relaxation of intelligence.
example.es: La estupidez es la relajación de la inteligencia.

definition: Not wanting or agreeing to do something.

example.en: Tom seems to be unwilling to tackle the problem.
example.es: Tom no parece estar dispuesto a abordar el problema.

definition: An idea that engenders a compulsive or irrational preoccupation, or the preoccupation thereby engendered.

example.en: The obsession didn't die down day or night.
example.es: La obsesión no remitía ni de noche ni de día.

definition: Made of material produced by the high-temperature firing of inorganic, nonmetallic rocks and minerals.

alternatives.definition: A hard, brittle, inorganic, nonmetallic material, usually made from a material, such as clay, then firing it at a high temperature.

example.en: She became rich by making ceramic pieces.
example.es: Ella se enriqueció haciendo piezas de cerámica.

definition: The act or quality of endorsing

alternatives.definition: Support from an important, renowned figure of a media (celebrity, politics, sports, etc.), to get back up.

example.en: Affection toward your loved ones and the endorsement of our truthful hopes are the keys to happiness.
example.es: El cariño a tus seres queridos y el respaldo a nuestras verdaderas esperanzas son la clave de la felicidad.

definition: a powder made from grain

alternatives.definition: To apply flour to something; to cover with flour.

example.en: He bought a lot of flour and oil.
example.es: Él compró un montón de harina y de aceite.

definition: In an indirect manner.

example.en: It's clear that his comments were intended to offend me indirectly.
example.es: Está claro que sus comentarios pretendían ofenderme indirectamente.

definition: Of or relating to the biological theory of evolution.

example.en: Darwin developed the evolutionary theory.
example.es: Darwin desarrolló la teoría de la evolución.

definition: The condition of enjoying anything.

example.en: The park boasts numerous amenities for the enjoyment of the public.
example.es: El parque cuenta con numerosas amenidades para el disfrute de la ciudadanía.
